items.name: Eyesaur the Repulsive Shplinter

items.description: A Shplinter to prove to Nevark the Hunter that you've defeated this island Sauroshell.
items.name: Tyranno the Despotic Shplinter

items.description: This voucher, generously offered to you by Charlie Endstown-Smisse, can be exchanged for a free Corktail from one of the Vulkania waitresses.
items.name: Free Corktail Voucher

items.description: This token is presented to warriors who win their Kolossium fights with flair. You can exchange it for a number of prizes, but, unfortunately for you, your tab at Astrub Inn isn't one of them.
items.name: Kolossoken

items.description: This leaf is actually more resistant than a Piwi Cape.
items.name: Large Green Leaf

items.description: This string's elasticity prevents it from being used to strangle parents-in-law.
items.name: Vine String

items.description: These 100% bio-degradable pants should have been a sure-fire hit with ecologists, but they ended up plumping for 100% synthetic pants from environmentally unfriendly workshops, because there were more colours to choose from.
items.name: Leaf Pants

items.description: This wood can be used to heat up cold Lenalds or barbecue wabbit paws.
items.name: Firewood

items.description: You might be salivating at the idea of this sticky earthworm squirming about in your mouth, but it's not for you!
items.name: Earthworm

items.description: These berries might look like pills, but we can guarantee that, just like Raymond Santho's cereals, they are organic. Well, the side effects are.
items.name: Sweet Berries

items.description: This coarse carpet, taken from the underground rabbit tunnels, smells of cawwots and sweat. You can't wait to snuggle up inside it, humming under a moonlit sky.
items.name: Wabbit Cawpet

items.description: This low-value kama was handed out to the Kwismas Haven monsters by Nicholas Kwismas. To use it in his Kwismas shop, just speak to Blimposta.
items.name: Bronze Chocolate Kama

items.description: This medium-value kama was handed out to the Kwismas Land monsters by Nicholas Kwismas. To use it in his Kwismas shop, just speak to Blimping Rich.
items.name: Silver Chocolate Kama

items.description: This high-value kama was handed out to the Kwismas Taiga monsters by Nicholas Kwismas. To use it in his Kwismas shop, just speak to Blimpineck.
items.name: Gold Chocolate Kama

items.description:
Any Enutrof'll tell you that only a Iop would keep his coins in a flimsy net rather than a chest.
This bag contains 20 silver chocolate kamas.
DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE.
items.name: Little Bag of Silver Chocolate Kamas

items.description:
Any Enutrof'll tell you that only a Iop would keep his coins in a flimsy net rather than a chest.
This bag contains 40 bronze chocolate kamas.
DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE.
items.name: Big Bag of Bronze Chocolate Kamas

items.description:
Any Enutrof'll tell you that only a Iop would keep his coins in a flimsy net rather than a chest.
This bag contains 20 bronze chocolate kamas.
DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE.
items.name: Little Bag of Bronze Chocolate Kamas

items.description: You got this star for helping the Thwee Kings.
items.name: Thwee Kings' Star

items.description: You got this star for beating the Itzting in the Kwismas Dungeon.
items.name: Itzting Star

items.description: You got this star for earning the required number of Beside the Points.
items.name: Jokey Goblimp Star

items.description: You got this star for making a Grump smile... or trying to...
items.name: Grumpy Star

items.description: You got this star for earning the required number of Good Points.
items.name: Workshop Star

items.description: You got this star for bringing back boxes of stolen gifts to Harry Kwismas.
items.name: Dungeon Star

items.description: The Goblimps absolutely love this type of sweet. The Astrubians enjoy them, too, but they don't say thanks when you offer them one.
items.name: Iced Chestnut

items.description: These toys make a noise when you press on them, and wet you if you pull the stem... just like clowns, in fact.
items.name: Toy for Good Boys and Girls

items.description: This egg is used to recruit the Wobots who make up the Wa Wabbit's personal bodyguards. The raw egg is dipped into Lenald liver oil, then placed in the Wobot's claw. Its guide then has to insert it into the orifice of his choice in an adventurer without breaking it. If he manages it, he makes it through to the next round in in the recruitment process. It is worth noting that this is behind the famous diarrhoea disaster.
items.name: Wabbit Egg

items.description: A bit of a cougar, this Cawwot is a favourite of young Wabbits and budding adventurers. Please note that its tapered shape and its absorbant abilities make it the first choice of cork against the famous diarrhoea disaster.
items.name: Mature Cawwot

items.description: All Wabbits would be prepared to kill, massacre, disembowel, decapitate, eviscerate, mutilate and even bite, just to taste a few drops of this juice. An Enutrof would do the same for just a few sips of kama infusion.
items.name: Grated Cawwot Juice

items.description: This Black Wabbit is so flat, you could use it to play music if they had such things as record players in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Flattened Black Wabbit

items.description: You have won a Beside the Point by travelling all the way around Kwismas Island in search of ill-mannered Gomplimps. They really gave you the run around. Take some time to catch your breath before heading off again, or you'll give yourself stitch.
items.name: Beside the Point

items.description: Thanks to Fixou's work, you hold, in your hands, all you need to attract the ardours of even the most aggressive Wabbits. Make sure you don't use it on hunting adventurers, it will make their limbs all soft.
items.name: Fixou's Syringe

items.description: Vlad the Blimpaler gives good points to those adventurers he deems worthy. If you're particularly well-behaved, you should have enough of them to get your hands on the Workshop Star.
items.name: Vlad the Blimpaler's Good Point

items.description: This bag contains the loot that Blimpristed coveted so much.
items.name: Blimpristed Loot

items.description: This bag contains the loot that Redolph coveted so much.
items.name: Redolph Loot

items.description: This bag contains the loot that Roachelf coveted so much.
items.name: Roachelf Loot

items.description: This bag contains the loot that Oogie Betty coveted so much.
items.name: Oogie Betty Loot

items.description: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make that old grump Blimpristed see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.
items.name: Scooger's Work Contract

items.description: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make that old grump Redolph see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.
items.name: Scooger's Work Contract

items.description: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make Blimpristed the Bad-Humoured see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.
items.name: Scooger's Work Contract

items.description: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make Oogie Betty see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.
items.name: Scooger's Work Contract

items.description: This crate contains a pingwin-launcher in pretty bad nick. Blimpilator should be able to repair it.
items.name: Pingwin-Launcher Crate

items.description: These parts will allow Blimpilator to repair all manner of things... like, say, a pingwin-launcher.
items.name: Replacement Part

items.description: Compress this pingwin a bit and it'll make excellent pingwin-launcher ammunition. They say that certain undesirable young men have used the same system on their over-defensive mothers-in-law.
items.name: Pingwin Ammo

items.description: If you want breath so stinky it could knock a Minotoror for six, you have two choices. Either chew on socks stolen from Enutrof corpses every day, or use some of this oil.
items.name: Breaded Fish Liver Oil

items.description: Made especially for you, this item (best kept chilled) can be used to open Blimpristed's grotto door. A tool such as this would have come in very handy for Jim Boned, the famous spy. He could have used it to open any bedroom door he liked... That's one way of making new enemies of jealous husbands.
items.name: Adjustable Hooklet

items.description: Harvested from the prickies when there's a particularly biting chill, these needles are valued by tailors who are skilled enough to work with mittens on.
items.name: Frozen Pricky Needles

items.description: Judging by the designs you found inside it, this bag must be worth a fortune. However, since you're a heartless, noble sort, you're going to give it back to its owner, right? Right?
items.name: Blimprover's Bag

items.description: This flat spanner can turn nuts, bolts and other screws. This tool is considered indispensable by the handymen who like to think that, without the Spanner of 12, the World would soon become unhinged.
items.name: Spanner of 12

items.description: This design is soaked, the instructions are almost illegible and the plans look like baby food. Sadly, you're going to have to make do. If you want to make the toy Nicholas has asked for, use the toy machine just like the Goblimp workers do.
items.name: Ruined Toy Design

items.description: Hector Kwismas gave you this Kwismas Card as you boarded the boat for Kwismas Island. It says "Merry Kwismas" on it. You might have the genius to figure out which holiday it's for, but will your intelligence be lauded during your lifetime? Nothing could be less certain.
items.name: Merry Kwiswas Card

items.description: You took this loot from the Golden Scarabugly. If you manage to get 3 of them to give to Harry Kwismas, you'll get the Dungeon Star!
items.name: Golden Scarabugly Loot

items.description: You took this loot from the Dragon Pig. If you manage to get 3 of them to give to Harry Kwismas, you'll get the Dungeon Star!
items.name: Dragon Pig Loot

items.description: You took this loot from the Soft Oak. If you manage to get 3 of them to give to Harry Kwismas, you'll get the Dungeon Star!
items.name: Soft Oak Loot

items.description: This notebook was written by an ingenious Goblimp, and it definitely contains a whole load of juicy information. Unfortunately, its stench is so nauseating that only a madman, a Porco or sobeone wid a gold would ever open it.
items.name: Notebook

items.description: To connoisseurs, this keg is worth all the kamas in the World. To uncultured drinkers who finish it too quickly, it's more likely to be worth a headache so violent it could split a Chafer's head in two.
items.name: Keg of Old Rum

items.description: This message was written by Shug Arkane and is addressed to Docker Hiseze. It should allow you to get hold of the key to Redolph's stable.
items.name: Letter from Shuga Kane

items.description: You sometimes come across stones such as this one in the icy bodies of Snowballs. Must be kept refrigerated. Some people use them as good luck charms, whilst others keep them for difficult post-party mornings, to cure persistent headaches or cover up bad breath.
items.name: Frozen Snowball Stone

items.description: This key should allow you to pay regular visits to Redolph the grump.
items.name: Redolph's Stable Key

items.description: The cover of this diary is covered in bitemarks and dried saliva. Most of the pages have been ripped out, and all that's left is a few pages of illegible, spidery writing.
items.name: Diary of an Unfortunate Entomologist

items.description: This page was torn from the diary of an unfortunate entomologist. The text is still legible, but certain stains on the paper seem to suggest that the manuscript's author is probably no longer with us.
items.name: Diary of an Entomologist, Page 3

items.description: They say that spoken words vanish and writing lives on. In this case, the author seems to have left a lot of himself in the text of this page.
items.name: Diary of an Entomologist, Page 6

items.description: Some people say that kanigers keep items stolen from lost travellers as trophies. Perhaps preservation and self-preservation go hand in hand?
items.name: Diary of an Entomologist, Page 15

items.description: Despite the freezing temperature, the information waiting to be deciphered on this page doesn't seem to have been kept very fresh.
items.name: Diary of an Entomologist, Page 17

items.description: The pen may well be mightier than the sword, but it stands no chance against an angry kaniger. The author of this travel journal learnt that the hard way.
items.name: Diary of an Entomologist, Page 18

items.description: This key will allow you to go and annoy Roachelf in his loft as many times as it takes.
items.name: Roachelf's Loft Key

items.description: This ice cube was collected from a Kwismas Island snowball that was a bit reluctant to part with it. It will only melt if you dip it in boiling water, or if you get it to listen to one of Jon Lemon's more heart-wrenching ballads.
items.name: Kwismas Ice Cube

items.description: The Slayhounds' diet, largely composed of mouldy adventurer meat and damaged souls, doesn't do much for their dental hygiene. White Slayhound fangs can be somewhat difficult to find. Take a good pair of tweezers and a life insurance policy with you if you want to get one.
items.name: White Slayhound Fang

items.description: The potion contained in this flask is 99% water, but the other 1% makes all the difference. It's usually used to soothe upset stomachs, although some Imp aeronauts use it to get rid of excess ballast.
items.name: Flask of Fibormax

items.description: Created by the famous Blimpulose out of pure barley sugar, this staff is great for anyone with a sweet tooth, and it's approved by the Goblimp Staff Placement Association to boot!
items.name: Goblimp Staff

items.description: Created by the famous Blimpulose out of pure barley sugar, this staff is great for anyone with a sweet tooth, and it's approved by the Goblimp Staff Placement Association to boot!
items.name: Goblimp Staff

items.description: Created by the famous Blimpulose out of pure barley sugar, this staff is great for anyone with a sweet tooth, and it's approved by the Goblimp Staff Placement Association to boot!
items.name: Goblimp Staff

items.description: These two oranges are starting to melt, little by little, at the bottom of your bag. Rather than wasting your time reading this splendid description, why not get on with the staff placing race?
items.name: Frozen Oranges

items.description: Leo gave you this cage after your star hunt. To release the slayhound, you're going to have to go to Kwismas Island. It refuses to get out anywhere else. If you haven't reached a high enough level, the cage won't open. It's for your own good. You wouldn't want to end up as Slayhound food, would you?
items.name: Caged Slayhound

items.description: This key is your daily entry pass to Oogie Betty's Ice Sanctuary. A warm welcome awaits... maybe.
items.name: Oogie Betty's Ice Sanctuary Key

items.description: This flat spanner can turn nuts, bolts and other screws. This tool is considered indispensable by the handymen who like to think that, without the Spanner of 14, the World would soon become unhinged.
items.name: Spanner of 14

items.description: This coin could probably be used to acquire something of value from one of the militias.
items.name: Wantoken

items.description: Ozz made a note of his measurements on this piece of parchment so that the outfit Paro Cabanne made for him would be a perfect fit. One of the measurements he's put for the breeches fitting was almost definitely made up to impress the seamstress...
items.name: Servant Ozz Measurements

items.description: This scroll was signed by Allister himself, and proves that its bearer is in the service of the kingdom of Amakna. It's written in BIG CAPITAL LETTERS so even a Wabbit will understand how important it is.
items.name: Document signed by Allister

items.description: This noble hair comes from the Prince of Wa's beard - at least that's what the certificate of authenticity that came with it claims. Legend has it that this relic has the power to awaken the Wabbit that lies dormant within you.
items.name: Prince of Wa Relic

items.description: They say that the Pandikazes soak their belts in the blood of their enemies... but you don't believe that nonsense, do you? It takes more than that to scare a Pandawushuka Disciple!
items.name: Pandikaze Belt

items.description: What's surprising about this cereal, besides its resistance to Frigost's extreme climate, is that it gives any milk it comes into contact with a delicate chocolatey flavour.
items.name: Chilled Frosteez

items.description: Hardened to Frigost's harsh climate, this flower is much more resistant than its delicate appearance would suggest. That said, to preserve the alchemic properties of such a rare plant, it must be handled carefully when harvested.
items.name: Chilled Snowdrop

items.description: Spines as sharp as Bworker's blades, scales as thick as Soft Oak Bark, and eyes as black as Crobak Feathers. This fish may be formidable, but served up on a plate it is quite simply delicious.
items.name: Chilled Icefish

items.description: Hard enough to scratch glass and dark enough to sap your morale, this rock has lost all of the heat of the lava from which it came. It would be perfect as a tombstone, as long as it's not your own.
items.name: Frozen Obsidian

items.description: This tree appears to tremble when you touch it. After all the axe blows you've dealt it, it's not surprising it's scared of you.
items.name: Chilled Aspen Wood

items.description: This meat is fresher than your breath and more appetising than your soulmate.
items.name: Fresh Meat

items.description: This species of Orchid is eaten by Dragoturkeys during the lovey-dovey season. It's probably a good idea to make sure there aren't any males behind you when you bend down to pick one.
items.name: Wild Orchid

items.description: The nostril-tickling fragrance of these droppings is very similar to the smell of pepper. Make sure you can tell them apart or you might just ruin your lunch!
items.name: Milirat Droppings

items.description: Within this collection, you'll find a series of engravings which illustrate one of Herdegrize the Mystic's works. It was printed in Astrub by a highly-respected Goblin. Yes, you heard right; a highly-respected Goblin!
items.name: The Legend of Jeff Stobbs

items.description: This substance is supposed to reveal all sorts of hidden things: texts written in invisible ink, unspeakable goings-on and deep, dark, hidden secrets. Use with caution. Avoid contact with eyes (contrary to all other powders!).
items.name: Revealing Powder

items.description:
This old document is covered in pictograms.
Double-click to use.
items.name: Battered Page

items.description:
You can win these tokens by defeating Grozilla and Grasmera in their den on the island of Vulkania. 
If you collect 20 of these tokens, you can take them to Tina Ninopogot and swap them for a Krolimea.
items.name: Krolimea Token

items.description: What's orange, makes you wince and burns holes in your lino? No, it's not a Prespic with a crankshaft...! If you're depressed, there's nothing better than a good swig of Fermented Cawwot Juice to put an end to all your worries. Consume diluted to avoid loss of sight and then life.
items.name: Fermented Cawwot Juice

items.description: If you're a townie it might be best not to try this Cawwot after twilight - you risk getting arrested by the Militia for noise pollution.
items.name: Cwunchy Cawwot

items.description: This crate is loaded with copies of the Cawwot consumers' sacred book. Wawitna will be chuffed - he can teach his brothers all about peace... Or at worst, he might be able to create a weading society.
items.name: Crate of Books

items.description: This humongous syringe will be just right for taking a sample of Wawitna's blood.
items.name: Syringe for Wawitna

items.description: This sample contains enough blood to feed an army of Moskitos for a whole year.
items.name: Wawitna's Blood Sample

items.description: This tablet seems to react when you touch it. It must be the work of an ingenious inventor. Unfortunately, your fat sausage fingers don't work on it...
items.name: Slablet

items.description: This dark stone can't be trusted. In fact, it feels like he's somehow watching your every move... Nah, it's just a figment of your imagination... Right?
items.name: Questionable Stone

items.description: An ingenious method of transport that would sell like hotcakes... if it worked, that is! Well, at least now you have a great zimmerframe, if nothing else!
items.name: Skarab

items.description: This item is reserved for tourists who actively participate in the competition between Vulkorog and Otamaisle. It can be exchanged for whatever tickles your fancy from Jennifer Engie and Clare Bonnet.
items.name: Vulkomaiken

items.description: You earned this scarf by competing for Otomaisle in the competition. If your team wins, 20 of these scarves will get you a special reward.
items.name: Otomaisle Scarf

items.description: You earned this scarf by competing for Vulkorog in the competition. If your team wins, 20 of these scarves will get you a special reward.
items.name: Vulkorog Scarf

items.description: The Hearts in this box were up for grabs... So, you grabbed! Their former owners probably won't find it in their hearts to forgive you.
items.name: Crate of Hearts

items.description: This message from Charlie's Agents has been stamped with the official seal and exudes a faint odour of cigars.
items.name: Message from the Agents

items.description: These designs seem to describe the fabrication of an infernal, explosive machine. The word "Bombadaboom" is written in bold on each sheet in particularly bad handwriting.
items.name: Stolen Designs

items.description: An Incandescent Sauroshell is like fire - you need to whack it when it's hot to get some good Shparks.
items.name: Incandescent Shpark

items.description: You're not quite sure how Bo Pye wins trophies like this one week after week, considering he's a complete and utter loner. Anyway, he offered you one of his Cannonballs to thank you for your participation. It's the same colour as him and far more interesting to talk to.
items.name: Bronze Cannonball

items.description: Rogues say that you can make a wicked bomb with this wick. It will probably shake the room too.
items.name: Wick Wick Boom

items.description: Tick. Tock. Tick. Tock. There's an alarm clock inside this parcel, but something tells you that you don't want to be there when it goes off.
items.name: Suspicious Parcel

items.description: This crystal is as shiny as it is fragile. Reduced to powder, it is sought-after by the Bontarian bourgeoisie as well as the dregs of Brakmar, who are usually on the lookout for get-rich-quick schemes.
items.name: Rock Crystal

items.description: At the time, keeping this tooth as a souvenir of your victory against Blam Stoker seemed like a good idea. In hindsight, it's pretty vile, even for a brute like you. After all, you're not a Bwork. Once you've finished your mission, get rid of this so-called trophy.
items.name: Blam Stoker's Cracked Tooth

items.description: Now you can jot down the different weights of the people that Bo Pye asked you to go and see. When you've finished you'll be able to reread everything you've noted and do lots of complicated maths. How lucky are you?!
items.name: Notepaper

items.description: Now you can jot down the different weights of the people that Bo Pye asked you to go and see. When you've finished you'll be able to reread everything you've noted and do lots of complicated maths. How lucky are you?!
items.name: Notepaper

items.description: Now you can jot down the different weights of the people that Bo Pye asked you to go and see. When you've finished you'll be able to reread everything you've noted and do lots of complicated maths. How lucky are you?!
items.name: Notepaper

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.name: Marked Card

items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!
items.name: Marked Card

items.description: This metallic disc is parituclarly heavy - no wonder it cost you so much. If you look at it closely, you'll see several miniscule grooves. You have no idea what it's for, but Ada Blablage's machine will know what to do with it. Deep down, you know this kind of object has no possible future.
items.name: Blablage Disc

items.description: There are a few fragmented sentences printed on this paper in a language incomprehensible to most mortals - with the exception of Ada Blablage and LaeTux, of course. Fortunately, the information needed for Bo Pye to win his bet is pretty clear.
items.name: Blablage Machine Reply

items.description: There are a few fragmented sentences printed on this paper in a language incomprehensible to most mortals - with the exception of Ada Blablage and LaeTux, of course. Fortunately, the information needed for Bo Pye to win his bet is pretty clear.
items.name: Blablage Machine Reply

items.description: It's customary for Sufokians to dissolve these pearls in vinegar to make pickled pearls. There's no point in mixing them with your fish and chips as it ends up rather costly, hence them only coming to play on special occasions.
items.name: Sand Pearl

items.description: You found these salt crystals in a shell. You were hoping for something else. Oh, life is so cruel...
items.name: Sea Salt Aggregate

items.description: These freshly laid eggs taste best when sipped out of a ladle. If you wait a few weeks, you'll see that they grow into absolutely massive gobstoppers.
items.name: Scaraleaf Eggs

items.description: Long considered no more than a type of wild grass, this cereal is the main ingredient used when making invigorating porridge. Consumed every morning, it'll help with internal plumbing issues as well as inopportune vapours that might arise throughout the day.
items.name: Wild Oats

items.description: This very heavy metal is mainly used for making diving helmets. It's also great when it comes to bringing down a party like a lead balloon, especially if you throw it at the musicians that are hitting bum notes all over the shop.
items.name: Leaded Bronze

items.description: Cut from dry branches, this rather dense wood is appreciated by superstitious sailors who think that, paradoxically, it warns of oncoming shipwrecks. This piece has been drifting for a long, long time.
items.name: Walnut Driftwood

items.description: Foggernaut philosophy says that Kraloves are able to foretell the future. True or false? Whichever it is, the fact remains that many Sufokians have adopted these creatures and regularly consult their divinatory fish bowls before making important decisions. Some really wealthy Foggers even keep theirs in crystal balls!
items.name: Forecasting Kralove

items.description: This five-leaf clover is so rebellious it even grows underground. Use it to season a warm soup and sit back and enjoy those cold, wet nights.
items.name: Marine Clover

items.description: This salty meat comes from those creatures that skinnydip at midnight. Don't pretend you haven't noticed them!
items.name: Salty Meat

items.description: Highly valued by clairvoyants, astrologists, oracles and those who want to look at the World a little differently... Jelly Juice tastes awful but offers wonderful insight when used as eye-drops. If a phoney asks you to ingest it, be careful - he might be planning to use your insides to see into the future.
items.name: Concentrated Jelly Juice

items.description: You got this blood sample from a Sauroshell that was almost as dirty as your crusty knickers.
items.name: Muddy Blood

items.description: You got this blood sample from a Sauroshell that was almost as moist as your silk thong.
items.name: Moist Blood

items.description: You got this blood sample from a Sauroshell that glowed almost as much as the boil that's smack bang in the middle of your forehead.
items.name: Incandescent Blood

items.description: You got this blood sample from a Sauroshell that was almost as insipid as your whole entire life.
items.name: Insipid Blood

items.description: You got this blood sample from a Sauroshell that was almost as dry as your sense of humour.
items.name: Dry Blood

items.description: This token proves your devotion to the Meridia, the Keepers of the Days listed in the Almanax. You can exchange it by going to see Xanamla... Or you can guard it with your life like a dragon perched on a pile of gold and precious stones.
items.name: Almoken

items.description: If you pray to the Meridia every day, then Antyklime Ax will give you a calendar page for each day that passes. Keep them safe: when the year's up, you'll be able to reap the rewards of your devotion. That means you can't use them to light camp fires, note down lottery numbers, peel vegetables or do any other shameful deeds.
items.name: Calendar Page

items.description: This bag contains an item stolen from an honest citizen of the City of Mercenaries. You should take it to Oremor, a Sram that celebrated the Night of the Bandeads by raiding rooms and taking what he pleased. Now he has to make sure that everything is returned safely. Oh yeah, and if you keep the loot, you won't be able to set foot in Astrub without suffering the wrath of the Council. There's no doubt about it; scavenging adventurers who count on free generosity only end up regretting it.
items.name: Stolen Item

items.description: These quivers have been kept in a humid environment. They're mouldier than... than... than something really mouldy!
items.name: Mouldy Quivers

items.description: The leather of these quivers is as dry as the tongue of a talkative Enutrof.
items.name: Cracked Quivers

items.description: The tenacious odour emanating from these quivers reminds you of your stepmother's perfume...
items.name: Hummin' Quivers

items.description: Hastily replaced arrows ended up destroying the skins of these quivers. Hey... at least it wasn't your skin!
items.name: Holey Quivers

items.description: The strands of long-haired leather and the fresh blood stains that adorn this club show that it's been used recently.
items.name: Blood-Encrusted Club

items.description: A hammer is used to smash in nails. A club is used to smash in heads.
items.name: Studded Club

items.description: This piece of ballasted hardwood gives more weight to its user's arguments.
items.name: Clumsy Club

items.description: This easy-to-use club will help you tie your enemies up in knots.
items.name: Gnarled Club

items.description: These tokens are awarded to people who've run into misfortune through no fault of their own. That's right: for once, it wasn't your fault! They can be traded in for rewards with Pauly Gees at the Amakna Castle zaap at [3,-5].
items.name: Compensoken

items.description: Plerti the Xelor is the author of numerous theories on time travel. This cylinder is his last experiment's prototype. Just one problem: he needs Meridian magic to make it work... Antyklime Ax will be able to tell you more at the Almanax Sanctuary.
items.name: Plerti's Cylinder

items.description: This extra-fine flour can be used to make pancakes, but also bread and other pastry delights. But can it be fearlessly consumed?
items.name: Amakna Flour

items.description: These grains form the base for various Amaknian dishes. You might want to make sure that they haven't been poisoned, however.
items.name: Grains of Wheat

items.description: If you roll this squidgy dough into a tight little ball, you can use it to mop up sauce from your dinner plate or plug your ears when rowdy youths start playing their god-awful music on the bus.
items.name: Doughy Centre

items.description: Some people believe that you shouldn't put all of your eggs in one basket but that's not to say you can't shamelessly hoard them in your inventory!
items.name: Fresh Kwak Egg

items.description: According to Kerub Crepin, there are dangerous magical items kept inside this crate. Judging by the creaking noises and acrid smoke pouring from it, we'd probably say he's right.
items.name: Crazy Xelor Crate

items.description: This is what happens to oranges when you leave them in the snow for too long. Much like shy young men when approached by pretty young women, they undergo a shocking colour change.
items.name: Blue Oranges

items.description: This is what happens to oranges when you leave them in the snow for too long. Much like shy young men when approached by pretty young women, they undergo a shocking colour change.
items.name: Blue Oranges

items.description: A light, yellow feather that smells of gas.
items.name: Sniffallrat Tofu Feather

items.description: This Gullipop feather has been shaped into a quill. If you don't know how to use it then just write the idea off.
items.name: Skribble Feather

items.description: A long, immaculate, slightly dusty feather.
items.name: White Owl Feather

items.description: This pass was originally Kerub's. It should allow you to access Astrub's public transport for free.
items.name: Kerub's Pass

items.description: This tuft of hair was designed by Clyde Parker but you get the impression that it's been thrown together with a few old Sabredon split ends.
items.name: Clyde Parker's Trophy

items.description: This wrist of this paw that you got from Baka Laive is hollow. So, you can use it as an ashtray, an inkwell or even a beer mug.
items.name: Baka Laive's Trophy

items.description: Some washerwomen claim that Parsley prevents dirt from resettling on recently washed clothes. Most people brush this off as an old wives' tale and stick to using Parsley for flavouring their soups and salads.
items.name: Bag of Parsley

items.description: There are few occasions when you should want to add something short and curly to your saucepan. One of them is when you're holding a handful of chervil. This aromatic herb will definitely give your dinner some oomph!
items.name: Bag of Chervil

items.description: Jives are a fun-loving herb with a surprisingly sharp edge. Make sure you soften them up before using them in the kitchen - unless you want to serve up your guests' tongues for pudding.
items.name: Bag of Jives

items.description: Taragorn is the unsung heir of Ovendoor and the rightful claimant to the thrones of herbdom. It takes a while to realise its full potential, but when used in conjunction with Lisran extract, its taste is powerful enough to wake the dead.
items.name: Bag of Taragorn

items.description: Sow these seeds on Plantalot Monday and they'll make sure you live a life full of skips and jumps, with an impressive dental record and a boundless libido. In short, they'll ensure you live a Wabbit's life.
items.name: Cawwot Seeds

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Gith Smold needs.
items.name: Jeweller Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Al Shab needs.
items.name: Butcher Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Frigostine needs.
items.name: Baker Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Francky needs.
items.name: Handyman Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Dutch needs.
items.name: Shoemaker Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.
items.name: Sword Smith Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Ingram Part needs.
items.name: Shield Smith Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.
items.name: Dagger Smith Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.
items.name: Axe Smith Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.
items.name: Hammer Smith Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.
items.name: Shovel Smith Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Clarisse Tocate needs.
items.name: Fishmonger Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Bea Fortax needs.
items.name: Bow Carver Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Bea Fortax needs.
items.name: Wand Carver Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Bea Fortax needs.
items.name: Staff Carver Bag

items.description: This bag contains some of the resources that Carla Garfield needs.
items.name: Tailor Bag

items.description: This huge, trashy necklace sells for an extortionate price, much like all useless things coveted by young guns intent on blowing their first pay check.
items.name: Bow Wow Collar

items.description: This dish's smell of mouldy cheese is enough to make the YeCh'Ti keel over. The taste is worse.
items.name: Hot Meal

items.description: To enjoy this sweet treat in all its glory, you need to keep your mouth loose and your tongue slobbery. Maybe that's why Bow Wows seem to enjoy it the most.
items.name: Frigostian Delicacy

items.description: This box is full of nuts, bolts and other miscellaneous stuff that might come in handy one day. It looks a bit like the inside of your brain when you're scrabbling desperately to answer the question "Where were you last night?!"
items.name: Box of Materials

items.description: With these crampons on your feet, sliding is a thing of the past! However, they won't stop you from stepping in Pingwin pats... And they're very, very difficult to clean.
items.name: Pair of Frigostian Crampons

items.description: This sword will barely have time to leave its sheath before the vapours it emits knock your enemies out without you having to raise a finger. Originally, it was a cheese knife, marketed with the slogan, "Cut de cheese, Windy Battle!"
items.name: Windy Battle Sword

items.description: This shield is as cold as ice, but it's willing to sacrifice.
items.name: Frigostian Shield

items.description: These daggers are enough to make anyone smile from ear to ear, even the grumpiest ratbags in the World of Twelve. Just ask Rekojeht in Brakmar if you don't believe it.
items.name: Squeaky Smilers

items.description: Billfer invented this saw for a contest in which carcasses had to be sawn into slices like salami. He won by a landslide after transforming four carcasses into 8595 slices in less than an hour.
items.name: Whack Saw

items.description: After many years of research and testing, this swatter was completed by a group of scientists intent on destroying the rare species known as Xambols. And do you know what? They succeeded.
items.name: Clanken Racket

items.description: This shovel is great for dislodging ice and snow, stunning corpses-to-be, and digging up cadavers that are long buried, if you're looking to make a quick kama.
items.name: Midwinter Spade

items.description: One kilopod of this ghastly cheese is enough to give a whale halitosis for one hundred years.
items.name: Icefish Cheese

items.description: Iops use this bag to bludgeon their enemies to death; most other classes are wily enough to look inside and find the ammo.
items.name: Ammunition Bag

items.description: This crop darkens the skin with pleasing effect. Some adventurers use it as a substitute for UV machines, which, naturally, do not exist in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Creematha Crop

items.description: On its own, this little stub of wood isn't much good. Don't throw it away though; you might stumble across the rest of a Slibou set and be glad of it!
items.name: Wooden Slibou Piece

items.description: It's green, it's ugly, it doesn't go with anything, but it could save your life! This is how Carla Garfield describes her latest creation.
items.name: Fisherman's Gilet

items.description: This document is proof that you've worked hard for the Frigostian effort. Collect 20 of them, and you'll really be something special.
items.name: Frigostian Employer's Reference

items.description: Woolly Bow Meows adore this Mimilk, and I daresay Clarice Peseay does too. Mac Gayver plans to use it to soften up the suit.
items.name: Mama Pingwin Mimilk

items.description: Neither Woolly Bow Meows nor Clarice Peseay adore this Mimilk. Mac Gayver plans to use it to soften up the suit.
items.name: Artificial Mama Pingwin Mimilk

items.description: Al Shab uses this blubber to keep his foodstuffs nice and warm. Mac Gayver is going to mix it with Frighog Lard to create a thermal insulating material.
items.name: Pingwobble Blubber

items.description: This blubber used to be used for keeping foodstuffs nice and warm, but it's too rubbery for that now. Mac Gayver is going to mix it with Frighog Lard to create a thermal insulating material.
items.name: Old Pingwobble Blubber

items.description: Al Shab uses this lard to add a gelatinous texture to his foodstuffs. Mac Gayver is going to mix it with Pingwobble Blubber to create a thermal insulating material.
items.name: Frighog Lard

items.description: This lard is well past its sell-by date, and Al Shab isn't a convincing enough salesman to flog it at a fraction of the recommended retail price. Mac Gayver is going to mix it with Pingwobble Blubber to create a thermal insulating material.
items.name: Spoilt Frighog Lard

items.description: These Woolly Piggoth Hairs are all scratchy and rough, but Dutch has a special treatment to make them silky. Mac Gayver wants to make some earmuffs with them.
items.name: Woolly Piggoth Fur

items.description: These Woolly Piggoth Hairs are as soft and smooth as can be. Mac Gayver wants to make some earmuffs with them.
items.name: Treated Woolly Piggoth Fur

items.description: Claws like this one make excellent crampons - Clyde Parker always carries a spare pair when he goes out hunting Pingwins. Mac Gayver prefers to transform them into non-slip soles.
items.name: Sabredon Claw

items.description: Claws like this one are much too fragile to be used to make crampons. All the same, Mac Gayver thinks he can transform them into non-slip soles.
items.name: Ceramic Sabredon Claw

items.description: This ice looks dirty because it's full of impurities. Mac Gayver is hoping to transform it into glass for some goggles.
items.name: Impure Translucent Ice

items.description: This ice is so pure that you can almost see your face in it when there's a full moon. Mac Gayver is hoping to transform it into glass for some goggles.
items.name: Pure Translucent Ice

items.description: This fur is as cold and uncomfortable as Gormor the Mangler's sense of humour. It's the main ingredient for Mac Gayver's thermolactic suit.
items.name: Frozen Fur

items.description: This fur is still very cold, but much softer than before. It's the main ingredient for Mac Gayver's thermolactic suit.
items.name: Tanned Frozen Fur

items.description:
This suit will enable you to survive extremely cold conditions in spite of the lack of oxygen.
Unfortunately, the suit is somewhat fragile, due to the poor quality of the materials used to make it.
items.name: Fragile Thermolactic Suit

items.description: This suit will enable you to survive extremely cold conditions in spite of the lack of oxygen. Unfortunately, the suit is somewhat cumbersome, due to the mediocre quality of the materials used to make it.
items.name: Crude Thermolactic Suit

items.description: This suit will enable you to survive extremely cold conditions in spite of the lack of oxygen.
items.name: Basic Thermolactic Suit

items.description: This suit will enable you to survive extremely cold conditions in spite of the lack of oxygen. Thanks to the superior quality of the materials used to make it, it is less cumbersome than a normal suit.
items.name: Superior Thermolactic Suit

items.description: This suit will enable you to survive extremely cold conditions in spite of the lack of oxygen. Thanks to the exceptional quality of the materials used to make it, it is very good at protecting its wearer from nasty surprises.
items.name: Exceptional Thermolactic Suit

items.description: This suit will enable you to survive extremely cold conditions in spite of the lack of oxygen. Thanks to the extraordinary quality of the materials used to make it, it is very good at protecting its wearer from the effects of sub-zero temperatures.
items.name: Extraordinary Thermolactic Suit

items.description: Doctor Hoo gave you this pocketwatch, which is said to have been crafted by the notorious Count Harebourg. Its hands have ground to a halt at 12.12. It may not tell the time properly, but it does tell you that something fishy's going on.
items.name: Frozen Pocketwatch

items.description: Contrary to popular belief, Kanigloos' long fangs are not made of frozen slobber. If you need proof, take this sample to the lab. It won't freeze, even under very low temperatures. This miracle of nature allows the common Kanigloo to indulge in its favourite hobby, slobbering, no matter how cold it gets outside.
items.name: Kanigloo Slobber

items.description: This little spray contains a radical remedy for the Lurgi. There's nothing like a good death to overcome sickness of any kind.
items.name: Mortal Remedy

items.description: The spooky moans of the ghost pirates haunt you to this day. WHOOOOO... Whooooo... Whoooo... Whooo... Whoo...
items.name: Echo of the Past

items.description: This strange particle used to spin at great speed around an Atomystique. You may not know it, but it almost smashed right into your face, which might have compromised your future... There's a temporal conundrum for you to mull over.
items.name: Little Piece of Future

items.description: P.A.N.T.S. followers hate the cold and, by extension, all things Icy Brockhard-y. You've been elected to rip the hearts out of these frozen fiends. Only an evil witch from a children's fairy-tale would be able to do so without a twinge of remorse, so if it helps, you can consider it an act of involuntary organ donation. Healthcare, after all, is beyond reproach.
items.name: Icy Brockhard Heart

items.description: This oil has soothing powers and is said to protect its user from excessive heat. Unfortunately, its odour is more reminiscent of the garbage disposal in Gordo McRamsay's kitchen than of the beaches on Moon Island.
items.name: Kokoko Oil

items.description: Everyone knows that Frosteez is an out-of-this-world cereal, but the ears in this sack really are something to behold. Everything about them - their size, their colour, their texture - seems to suggest that they've undergone some kind of shock treatment. Are they still edible, do you think? The specialists swear blind that they are, but that's probably because they're employed by a huge food-processing guild.
items.name: Sack of GM Frosteez

items.description: You removed this tiny ice sculpture from the grottoes in the Fangs of Glass, and you have a funny feeling that it will never melt. You could use it as a paperweight, or you could give it to Jamie Coggut in the hope of saving Frigost. Being a born hero, you're going to go with the second option, right? Right?
items.name: Eternal Frost from the Frozen Grottoes

items.description: This is an exceptional batch of heavenly honey. The Celestial Bearbarian, fussy eater and god-king of the Bearbarians, is kind of a big deal, after all. Careful you don't eat too much of the rich, sugary liquid, as it can cause buzzing in the ears.
items.name: Bronzed Liquid Honey

items.description: It's said that this claw was ripped from the hands of none other than Djaul. If the stories are true, the protector of Descendre lost it during an epic battle with his arch-rival, Jiva. Whatever the truth is, you should keep it away from direct heat so that it doesn't lose its sharpness.
items.name: Frosted Claw

items.description: A heavy, uncomfortable helmet that definitely can't be used in this state. If you want to repair it, you'll have to find someone who's used to dealing with extreme temperatures. If there's a Foggernaut somewhere in the vicinity, he'll probably be able to help.
items.name: Dented Diving Bell

items.description: This part is what guarantees that Pingwinches stay airtight when they dive into icy water. They'd be in quite a fix if their frostmotors failed whilst they were fishing under the surface, not least because they'd be late bringing back fish for Sylargh's supper.
items.name: Airtight Pingwinch Valve

items.description: This high-quality material was removed from a particularly dumpy Dumple. As well as being thicker, heavier and oilier than regular leather, it's waterproof and easy to take care of. Do its good qualities never end? Er... Well, it tastes like a slice of mud pie. As long as you're not planning on getting lost in a snowdrift and having to eat your boots to survive, you should be fine.
items.name: Oily Dumple Leather

items.description: This helmet is made of cold, hard metal. It was created on a frosty forge, worn by a cold-hearted heathen and used to send many a shiver down innocent spines. If all that isn't enough to put you off it, then I must commend you on your thermal vest. The Frigostians chills will never get you under there!
items.name: Stalak Helmet

items.description: Nothing is sacred to you, is it? Barging in and ripping off a ghost's clothes like that? The fact that he was already dead is no excuse at all. You should be ashamed of yourself! Thanks to you and your careless behaviour, all the ghosts in the cemetery are shaking in their tombs, convinced that the invasion of the body snatchers has begun.
items.name: Wintry Shroud

items.description: Bearbarians are very fond of eating this plant as part of a salad, with honey sauce and pine nuts. The greedier bears bulk up their meal with hunks of Mastogob or pickled Larvae. A good Ygrade Plant salad in the morning will provide you with enough pep to stay wide awake all day long, dontcha know!
items.name: Ygrade Plant Shoot

items.description: Mina Spirit says that Celestial Wax can be used to stifle the complaints of tormented spirits. Bearbarians don't have much use for silencing spirits; they prefer to use it for preserving foodstuffs. But where does this mysterious wax come from? The ears of the Celestial Bearbarian himself? Surely not... But maybe. Just maybe.
items.name: Celestial Wax

items.description: If the screams of the living dead get right up your nose, the moaning and groaning of ghosts grinds your gears, and you're overly frustrated with the sighing of all those lost souls, then this is the solution you're looking for! Simply stick one of these plugs in each ear and restful sleep will be yours at long last! Keep in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and strong odours. In case of accidental swallowing, consult your local exorcist.
items.name: Hauntaway Plugs

items.description: You wove this veil on the loom in the Cavern of Destiny. What is it exactly? You don't really know, but you can feel tears forming in your eyes just by looking at it. When you touch it, you begin to sob uncontrollably. Don't tell me you've finally gone soft!
items.name: Veil of Sadness

items.description: You gave Klime the Shoemaker a good kicking, and such was the violence of your frenzied attack that he had a nosebleed. Thanks to the Icy Claw, your enemy's blood has frozen solid, which suits you down to the ground, and should suit Nileza as well.
items.name: Klime's Icy Blood

items.description: This tear is nothing short of miraculous: who would have thought Missiz Freezz was capable of crying? The Veil of Sadness that you wove must have had something to do with it, but you'd rather believe that the smithmagus finally cracked because you defeated her.
items.name: Tear from Missiz Freezz

items.description: Thanks to this viscous liquid, which is the product of many years of research and experimentation, Sylargh's machines continue to function while the plunging temperatures chill the bones of the inhabitants of Frigost. You have to admit, Sylargh is pretty handy, man.
items.name: Sylargh's Anti-Freezing Oil

items.description: If I told you that the liquid contained within this flask was responsible for stopping time on Frigost Island, would you believe me? No, you're not that naïve. And yet... you've been staring at it for a good ten minutes now. Or was Xelor's clock simply stuck?
items.name: Water Clock Liquid

items.description: These ashes are all that remain of the last artificial elemental creature that you killed. The lazier inhabitants of Frigost use them in place of cheese when they want a toasted sandwich but can't be bothered to turn the grill on.
items.name: Elemental Ashes

items.description: I'm sorry to be the one to break this to you, but even this robust plank is better at protecting you from sneak attacks than your Feca guildmate.
items.name: Reinforced Plank

items.description: This weatherproof leather is thicker than the elastic in your underpants, and far more flexible. It has the same rancid odour, mind you.
items.name: Thick Leather

items.description: If you soak a Chafer's Leather Briefs in this ectoplasmic, magic-filled residue, you'll cool his ardours for at least a century.
items.name: Frosplasm

items.description: This high-precision mechanism is good for nothing in this state. You could melt it down and make a button to replace the one that fell off your trousers.
items.name: Broken Mechanism

items.description: Apparently this ore reacts violently to water, not unlike you, it has to be said. Luckily for your peers, the day of your annual bath is fast approaching. This year, remember to take your clothes off, and avoid using this block to scrape the dead skin off your feet. The results would be... explosive.
items.name: Block of Taroudium

items.description: This block of Taroudium gives off so much heat you could roast a cartful of Mastogob legs with it and it would still be hot. Are you sure it's safe to keep in your pocket?
items.name: Block of Enriched Taroudium

items.description: The trophy Darwin Chester gave you looks like a plain old piece of Leatherball Leather. When you look a little closer... you see it in close-up.
items.name: Darwin Chester's Trophy

items.description: You have to fill this flask up with liquid from Count Harebourg's Water Clock. The only similar experience you've ever had is filling up pint glasses at the tavern and liquidating your assets... However will you manage?
items.name: Winterglass Flask

items.description: Do not open under any circumstances - especially not burning curiosity!
items.name: Sealed Letter

items.description: Do not open under any circumstances - especially not burning curiosity!
items.name: Sealed Letter

items.description: This evil eye is pretty old and battered. Don't count on it to give you the gift of second sight.
items.name: Sorceress's Eye

items.description: This is a page ripped from the journal in which Professor Imagarihs tracked his progress.
items.name: Extract from Professor Imagarihs's Journal

items.description: This residue is an essential ingredient of the antidote to Biopantie poison.
items.name: Alchimera Residue

items.description: These leaves look crude and unwieldy, but they have so many uses that absolutely everyone wants some of them in their bag.
items.name: Chunky Leaves

items.description: These petals are very rare indeed today, because the special fertiliser needed to keep their tree alive has all but disappeared.
items.name: Petals of Siffonia

items.description: Correctly administered you know where, this antidote will end the paralysis caused by the Biopantie's poison.
items.name: Antidote for Professor Imagarihs

items.description: If you're reading these lines, it means that the Biopantie's poison has put all my basic functions on hold. You must obtain the following ingredients and then ask Jon Burrowman to prepare the antidote. He'll know what to do. You can get Alchimera Residue from monsters, Chunky Leaves in the plant pots on the walls, and Petals of Siffonia from Bisale Vinlenta. Hurry! Future Me is fading fast!
items.name: Note from Professor Imagarihs

items.description: This box is filled to the brim with explosives. Sab O'Terr forgot to tell you how dangerous this cargo was going to be.
items.name: Box of Explosives

items.description: This box is full of tools used by demolition experts. Sab O'Terr will be glad to get them back.
items.name: Box of Tools

items.description: Bearbarians are very fond of eating this plant as part of a salad, with honey sauce and pine nuts. The greedier bears bulk up their meal with hunks of Mastogob or pickled Larvae. A good Ygrade Plant salad in the morning will provide you with enough pep to stay wide awake all day long, dontcha know!
items.name: Ygrade Plant Shoot

A good Ygrade Plant salad in the morning will provide you with enough pep to stay wide awake all day long, dontcha know!
items.name: Ygrade Plant Shoot

items.name: Ygrade Plant Shoot

items.description: For your eyes only.
items.name: Message from Mayor Cantile

items.description: It's highly likely that this bag contains a message, and you should open it and find out. The problem is, you're convinced that if you do, something terrible will happen. The skull and crossbones engraved on the lock was your first clue.
items.name: Messenger's Bag

items.description: This Bow Meowette won't do its business in your rucksack, won't complain when you forget to feed it, won't shed its fur everywhere, won't wake you up at the crack of dawn, and is available all year round. What's more, you can do anything you like to it and it won't say a word. In other words, you may have just found your soulmate.
items.name: Stuffed Ginger Bow Meowette

items.description: The only part of this message that you can read is the signature. The rest is in a language that appears incredibly difficult to pronounce, and yet seems strangely familiar. I wonder if you've heard it somewhere before...
items.name: An Enigmatic Message

items.description: Sylargh has written this short message in the language of the Ice Goblins. Did he pick up a few words while holidaying on Sakai Island? Who knows. One thing's for certain, the Imp and Missiz Freezz are up to something.
items.name: A Translated Message

items.description: This very precise map of Frigost Island, sketched by Sylargh, isn't finished yet. There are several red crosses on it, each marked "invasion point".
items.name: Unfinished Aerial Map

items.description: This hide is as smooth as glass and almost transparent. You're not sure where it came from, but something tells you you're better off not knowing.
items.name: Magic Hide

items.description: This map, engraved on a magical skin, could lead Missiz Freezz's Armarines straight to their target. It might also lead the inhabitants of the Snowbound Village straight to their deaths, which is a bit of a failing for a map.
items.name: Plan for the Snowbound Village Invasion

items.description: This magic candle is capable of warming any hole into which it is introduced. Particularly fashionable at the start of the 16th century, the Frigostian aristocracy would use them to illuminate their evening parties. The secret to their manufacture was lost during the big freeze and only a very small number remain today.
items.name: Magic Candle

items.description: Pashushu was a powerful Shushu that could create violent gusts of wind. Alma imprisoned it in this statue so that he could take advantage of its power, but you need real patience to master Pashushu's many moods. As luck would have it, you put the statue in this box, not because you're scared of Shushus, but because you're so clumsy you might have broken it if you hadn't.
items.name: Statuette of Pashushu Box

items.description: This old lock will find a new lease of life as the clasp to your chastity belt.
items.name: Lock from an Old Chest

items.description: This splinter may look harmless, but in the right hands it's a lethal weapon. Stick it in your enemy's finger, wait for the wound to become infected, and then wait another ten years for the infection to finish them off. A simple, albeit slow, way of defeating the Frigost dungeon keepers.
items.name: Splinter from a Sign

items.description: You still bear the scars of having contracted Dremoan Rot.
items.name: Putrid Residue

items.description: The splodge on the sole of your boot is all that remains of the worm from the Bearbarian Hive that you stamped on. It smells delightfully of honey, so perhaps you should think about using it to mask the stench of your feet.
items.name: Crushed Worm

items.description: You took this sample in the Winter Gardens, but you can't guarantee its effects.
items.name: Sample of Alchemical Liquid

items.description: When assembled correctly in a workshop, these bits and pieces will give life to an artificial being.
items.name: Box of Mechanical Parts

items.description: When assembled correctly in a workshop, these bits and pieces will give life to an artificial being.
items.name: Box of Mechanical Parts

items.description: When assembled correctly in a workshop, these bits and pieces will give life to an artificial being.
items.name: Box of Mechanical Parts

items.description: When assembled correctly in a workshop, these bits and pieces will give life to an artificial being.
items.name: Box of Mechanical Parts

items.description: When assembled correctly in a workshop, these bits and pieces will give life to an artificial being.
items.name: Box of Mechanical Parts

items.description: You're now the proud owner of a prototype artificial intelligence, which, it has to be said, is currently as useless as a gathering of your in-laws. Mind you, unlike your in-laws, it won't stay useless.
items.name: KC RUR Prototype

items.description: This high quality leather was tanned using revolutionary methods, and an expert would surely pay a handsome sum for it.
items.name: Tanned Leather

items.description: When the blade of this sword is plunged into your enemy's entrails, it instantly freezes their blood. To avoid misuse by unruly adventurers, it cannot be equipped.
items.name: Frozen Weapon

items.description: You found this strange gem in the depths of Grohlum's pockets. When you touch its vibrant surface, you're overcome with nostalgia, without really understanding why. They say diamonds and regrets are forever, so maybe you'd better stop stroking the pebble if you don't want to sink into depression.
items.name: Stone of Yesteryear

items.description: This beautifully crafted piece of metal was found lodged in a Sinistro's chest, which explains why the oversized owl was making such a funny noise.
items.name: Golden Cog

items.description: Created by Missiz Freezz in the depths of the Frostforge, this magic alloy appears to be indestructible, unbreakable, incorruptible and untarnishable. Basically, it's hardcore.
items.name: Eternal Metal

items.description: According to Henual, the Overseer of Time, this high precision chronomagic device should be able to regulate the currents of temporal flux that swirl around Count Harebourg's Water Clock. Will it work as planned? Well, it's not like you've got any better ideas.
items.name: Temporal Stabiliser

items.description: It's not just the watch that's working: destiny is ticking away as well... According to Decimandi, you should be able to use this enchanted pocketwatch to dispel the temporal ice that surrounds the Water Clock's minute hand. Mind you, if you believe that, you probably believe in Granny Capping's Dofus as well.
items.name: Working Pocketwatch

items.description: This is an invitation to a fetish evening in Klime's private quarters. When the party's over, I'm pretty sure you'll be able to think of another meaning for the initials S and M, and not just "sick monster".
items.name: Hazieff Taroun's Invitation

items.description: Without the three other bits, this piece of key is as useless as a portable fan on Frigost.
items.name: Nileza's Piece of Key

items.description: Without the three other bits, this piece of key is as useless as a portable fan on Frigost.
items.name: Sylargh's Piece of Key

items.description: Without the three other bits, this piece of key is as useless as a portable fan on Frigost.
items.name: Klime's Piece of Key

items.description: Without the three other bits, this piece of key is as useless as a portable fan on Frigost.
items.name: Missiz Freezz's Piece of Key

items.description: This key will allow you access to the Water Clock Tower. Just don't expect it to protect you once you're inside.
items.name: Water Clock Tower Key

items.description: Unlike other alchemic potions of dubious origins, you know that this is an authentic Nileza creation. How can you be so sure? Well, you were there when it was made. Unfortunately, you also know that it has terrible side-effects, including complete paralysis.
items.name: Nileza's Longevity Potion

items.description: This biscuits are as hard as stone. With a bit of practise, they can be used to knock Gullipops or old people off Frigost pier.
items.name: Mina Spirit's Biscuits

items.description: These notes reveal Missiz Freezz's thoughts on how to escape the effects of the curse. She speculates that dying in order to be reincarnated in another body could be a way of leaving the island without suffering any side effects. Strangely, the notepaper gives off the same intoxicating scent as Emma Skulated's perfume.
items.name: Missiz Freezz's Notes

items.description: This notebook is in fact a diary, and Emma Skulated has written down the details of her many missions in it. Judging by the number of pages she's filled, Sram should be very proud of his disciple.
items.name: Emma Skulated's Notebook

items.description: You have Emma Skulated's dark secret in your hands, but you're not sure if it's the fruits of modern science, or the results of a madman's terrible experiments. No one will ever know.
items.name: Emma Skulated's Secret

items.description: This implement of torture is used to introduce vast amounts of liquid into the bodies of prisoners in a very short amount of time, no matter which orifice is used. Once it caught on in the taverns of Frigost, it was banned, then reserved only for use by qualified alchemists.
items.name: Pocket Funnel

items.description: Mini Inuits use similar muffs when handling dangerous metals, primarily to avoid cutting themselves and contracting tetanus.
items.name: Pair of Muffs

items.description: The blade of this leather slicer is so sharp that it can sever verrucae from soles in the blink of an eye, and cut through even the toughest of leathers.
items.name: Leather Slicer

items.description: Count Harebourg's workers use this pick almost exclusively during the winter months to shatter ice and the skulls of unfortunate Mini Inuits.
items.name: Hammer-Pick

items.description: "What's this Xelor magnifying glass for?" is the question anyone who doesn't know the answer asks themselves.
items.name: Xelor Magnifying Glass

items.description: This is a magic marble. You don't know how you know, you just know that you know. What you don't know is how to use it, and sticking it up your nostril doesn't seem to have had any effect, apart from stopping you from being able to breathe. Perhaps that's its magic power!
items.name: Magic Marble

items.description: You kept this as a souvenir from your shell hunts. Is it the slightly rotten fragrance or the moist, pinkish appearance which keeps you coming back for more? Only you know for sure.
items.name: Vulkanian Shell

items.description: At first glance, Vulkanian Shirts look to be plain old Barbrossa Shirts with the labels changed, shipped over to be sold to tourists at hiked up prices. Could the packaging industry really be that careless and/or unethical?
items.name: Vulkanian Shirt

items.description: The flour ground using Barley is very popular with fans of light, airy bread. The Lousy Pigs, on the other hand, prefer to use it to make a stodgy gruel that not even a starving Trool would touch.
items.name: Bag of Stolen Barley

items.description: Rye has been considered magical by many civilisations through the ages, but the Lousy Pigs couldn't care less. They just crush the grains between their bum cheeks to produce a rough powder used as an exfoliating scrub.
items.name: Bag of Stolen Rye

items.description: Only a handful of people have ever tasted the wheat pancakes Lousy Pigs like eating, but the reactions are unanimous: they taste disgusting, serve absolutely no purpose in terms of nutrition, and are as hard and unappetising as a Plain Crackler. The only thing they're good for is skimming on Cania Lake.
items.name: Bag of Stolen Wheat

items.description: It's said that the Lousy Pigs use Malt to distil a very strong alcohol which is at the root of the poor eyesight suffered by many of the species.
items.name: Bag of Stolen Malt

items.description: This dust is supposed to be divine in some way, although Orreip was keeping shtum about what he needs it for. Yet another mystery of the wide and wondrous Krosmoz.
items.name: Stardust

items.description: This dust is supposed to be divine in some way, although Orreip was keeping shtum about what he needs it for. Yet another mystery of the wide and wondrous Krosmoz.
items.name: Stardust

items.description: This dust is supposed to be divine in some way, although Orreip was keeping shtum about what he needs it for. Yet another mystery of the wide and wondrous Krosmoz.
items.name: Stardust

items.description: This document certifies that you are capable of exercising the role of Undertaker.
items.name: Undertaker Certificate

items.description: This document certifies that you are capable of exercising the role of Healer.
items.name: Healer Certificate

items.description: This document certifies that you are capable of exercising the role of Sentinel.
items.name: Sentinel Certificate

items.description: Some frail, mentally under-developed Wabbits use Rock cards instead of the real thing when stoning enemies.
items.name: Wooden Card: Rock

items.description: Hold this card above your head during a storm. It won't do much to stop the rain, but it'll probably attract a lightning bolt, which will light your way for a brief instant.
items.name: Wooden Card: Paper

items.description: There's no point in trying to cut your loved one's whiskers or your pet's ears with this card. At best, you'll get cramp; at worst, you'll get a nasty bite.
items.name: Wooden Card: Scissors

items.description: This Cawwot was taken from the Wabbits, but it has absolutely no commercial value at all. Perhaps that's why Old Time Wabbit uses it to keep score (his faulty short-term memory certainly won't do the trick).
items.name: Lenald Cawwot

items.description: This cawwot... pardon, callot... shines like a thousand bonfires when it's pointed at the sun. This strange effect can probably be explained by the essential oils it is dipped in before each use.
items.name: High Noon Callot

items.description: Unlike other mushrooms, this one needs sunlight to survive. That means you can safely slip it into your pants without having to worry about it running riot down there.
items.name: High Noon Mushloom

items.description: The slightest contact with these weeds will have you dying to get naked and rub up against all things green: magic beans, Green Piwis, the Itzting, nettles, etc.
items.name: High Noon Weeds

items.description: You mustn't underestimate the aroma given off by this Wabbit meat. It'll turn even the most adamant vegetarian into a wide-eyed, insatiable carnivore with juice dripping off his chin.
items.name: Glilled Wabbit Paw

items.description: Nobody can resist this tasty, unique dish... Especially not Dees, the Meridia of Gluttony! You'd better hurry up and make your delivery before that roast hog gets wind of it.
items.name: High Noon Caesal Salad

items.description: This travel journal is in a pitiful state. Most of the pages have been torn out and/or chewed up. Only a few raggedy pages are still legible.
items.name: Ripped Travel Journal

items.description: A patchwork of myths and stories, this book was written in Piglet Blood on Lousy Pig skin by a mad poet called Ludba Al-Derzah. The cover itself is made of skin from none other than the Dragon Pig. As for the contents... They're so preposterous that reading too many pages might give you a heart attack.
items.name: Necronobacon

items.description: This Cawwot looks about as fresh as your breath in the morning (ie. Its stench could kill a wildebeest).
items.name: Fresh Cawwot

items.description: This rustic wax was crafted using Boar Hair and Boar Snouts, among other things. Nobody knows whether the name "Blibli" is a nickname for Boars, an abbreviation of "bling-bling" or something else. Frankly, it sounds ridiculous, but who knows? Maybe in hundreds of years everyone'll be using it. Ha!
items.name: Blibli Wax

items.description: You wrestled this trophy off a gruesome, terrifying, life-threatening... squirrel. You can expect some jibes once your pals find out, but they'll never know just how harrowing the experience really was.
items.name: Quarrelsome Squirrel Fur

items.description: You got this divine flail head from Xa, the Meridia of Endurance. You have no idea why he had a spare flail head on him, but one thing's for sure: you'll feel as light as a feather once you've got rid of it.
items.name: Xa's Flail Head

items.description: Fallanster, the head of Astrub city council, has entrusted you with his seal so you can enter the room where the Treaty of Six was signed. You should avoid using this ring for any dodgy business unless you want to spend the rest of your days rotting in a jail cell in the City of Mercenaries.
items.name: Fallanster's Seal

items.description: When you touch the symbol painted on this puppet's face, you experience a sharp flash of pain in your head. There's no doubt about it: powerful magic is afoot. How else would you explain this headache? There's nothing in your head to hurt!
items.name: Puppet Head

items.description: This rum wasn't made in a day – closer to a century, in fact. The Merkaptans use it to brighten up their long shifts in Merkator's base, and to wrench their enemies' guts.
items.name: Mariner Rum

items.description:
Used to detect certain types of particles suspended in water, this technomagic probe is also able to take samples. If only it could fight in your stead, feed your family, and hold a conversation with your mother-in-law, it would be perfect.
(To activate the device, go near the Pandawa Temple, then double-click.)
items.name: Barbascout

items.description: It must have been Kham, the Meridia of Cleanliness, that created this miracle liquid. No spot can resist: the gods even use it to clean their acts up. The Super Cleaner destroys impurities, microbes, and nauseating smells. Results are guaranteed. If accidentally swallowed, contact your local mortician.
items.name: Super Cleaner

items.description: This device measures all the angles, the distances, the angles of the distances, the distances of the angles, and the length of your nose hair before saving it all in its memory. At the very least, we can say that it appears to be a great deal more useful than you.
items.name: Topographic Instrument

items.description: Jaime Swatt seems to really have a thing for the Steamcrabs found in the hallways of the Sunktuary. As for you, you prefer the crabs along Sufokia's shores, especially in a salad.
items.name: Steamcrab Specimen

items.description: Most handymen only dream of having tools like these: trusty, precise, solid, easy to handle – they have all the qualities that you lack.
items.name: Merkaptan Toolbox

items.description: This sheet of paper is covered with incomprehensible mathematical formulas. It seems like such a waste when you realise everything else the paper could have been used for.
items.name: Merkator's Notes

items.description: This report concerning Merkator's activities is meant for the members of Sufokia's Sea Council. If you're not part of the council, you're not allowed to know what's in the report. Just reading this description is an infraction punishable by drowning. And shaming. You should be ashamed of yourself.
items.name: Theo Dolite's Report

items.description: With no help from anyone, this Barbascout took the necessary samples all while putting up with the abuses and attacks of Merkaptans and their Steamcrabs. Would you have had such resolve in the same circumstances?
items.name: Dented Barbascout

items.description: Skale has given you this sheet to help you train the recruit, according to various parameters, in combat.
items.name: Training Sheet

items.name: Filled-in Training Sheet

items.name: Explosive Recruit's Sheet
