items.description: It grows like the number of flies around a dung heap, and smells pretty much the same.
items.name: Mushroomy Flower

items.description: Perfect for decorating your feet, this mushroom can also be worn as an earring.
items.name: Flowery Mushroom

items.description:
The cries of an army of Skeunk groupies aren't as piercing as the sound of this whistle.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Nyan Whistle

items.description: A wrong amount in the recipe can have disastrous consequences for those who'll eat it.
items.name: Space Feed

items.description: Fiziks has put this net together. Even though it's crude, it should be enough to capture a Flying Bow Meow.
items.name: Flying Bow Meow Net

items.description: According to what's written on this envelope, it's addressed to Catvanna.
items.name: Envelope for Catvanna

items.description: There are some sheets of papers with drawings, some sketches, a few previous attempts and several crayons.
items.name: Charblie's Box

items.description: This spikily-haired skin is so repugnant that you couldn't even think of scratching your back with it... or could you?
items.name: Old Skin

items.description: This spikily-haired skin is so repugnant that you couldn't even think of scratching your back with it... or could you?
items.name: Old Skin

items.description: This spikily-haired skin is so repugnant that you couldn't even think of scratching your back with it... or could you?
items.name: Old Skin

items.description: This Boulder Biter eye leaves you stone cold.
items.name: Petrified Eye

items.description: This Boulder Biter eye leaves you stone cold.
items.name: Petrified Eye

items.description: This Boulder Biter eye leaves you stone cold.
items.name: Petrified Eye

items.description: It looks like any old Crobak's eye, but it is in fact capable of summoning Sharinkat's Spirit.
items.name: Ush Iwa's Eye

items.description: Go and see Mawtalo's Hawe to get the answew to the Mad Hattew's widdle.
items.name: Riddle Voucher

items.description: Go and see the Sleepwalking Dormouse to hear a story that'll send you to sleep.
items.name: Story Voucher

items.description:
The skeletal hand of Larry Slim is still firmly clutching the golden pussmina.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Larry Slim's Hand

items.description: This Great Game Guard tried to stop you... and now he's a little whacked.
items.name: Damaged Card

items.description: You were attacked by some Great Game Guardians... the attackers folded quickly.
items.name: Folded Card

items.description: Much bigger than its kin in the World of Twelve, it's also more appreciated for its succulent flesh, which is normally eaten raw.
items.name: Catuna

items.description: Much bigger than its kin in the World of Twelve, it's also more appreciated for its succulent flesh, which is normally eaten raw.
items.name: Catuna

items.description: Much bigger than its kin in the World of Twelve, it's also more appreciated for its succulent flesh, which is normally eaten raw.
items.name: Catuna

items.description: Much bigger than its kin in the World of Twelve, it's also more appreciated for its succulent flesh, which is normally eaten raw.
items.name: Catuna

items.description: This plant is used in the creation of impromptu anaestitics.
items.name: Bundle of Hemp

items.description: This plant is used in the creation of impromptu anaestitics.
items.name: Bundle of Hemp

items.description: This plant is used in the creation of impromptu anaestitics.
items.name: Bundle of Hemp

items.description: It may look like an earthworm, but this larva will eventually turn into an enormous Itsh and you'd have to buy an enormous fishing pole to stick it on your hook.
items.name: Mutant Larva

items.description: This viscera is used by Felinjas to strangle their victims and by Kittemourais as palliatives. And thanks to you, Fiziks has almost discovered a new use.
items.name: Great Game Entrails

items.description:
Since being little, you've been told that the stinkier a cheese is, the better it is. But you're not fooled! However, you're ready to drink the contents of this vial whose powerful stench is enough to kill all vegetation within several kilokametres.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Anti-parasitic Flask

items.description:
It looks as if something has started to eat this map.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Gnawed Map

items.description: What's this card doing in your pocket? Another one of Ecaflip's tricks? Hard to say... There are forces in the Krosmoz that even the gods can't control...
items.name: Card of Fate

items.description: This token is no longer in circulation, but it has kept all its value. You can exchange it for new sharivakens with the merchant haunting Lhambadda Manor in Astrub City.
items.name: Antique Sharivaken

items.description: The seal of an authority lost to the ages, Shariva of Antiquity with beard and braids, or something else? The heads of this coin keeps a team of numismatists busy full-time. And time is money: the common view is that this coin has what it takes to make you lose both. On the flipside of the coin, Shariva's Favourites think that stormy horizons could be in store for you, now that you are in its possession.
items.name: Small Change

items.description: This Trump Card might be useful to you... for everything. For want of cutting a clubs, will this this Trump Card allow you to cut in line? To get carte blanche for the destination of your choosing? To find out, it's up to you to turn it over and make it your ace in the hole! Unless it cuts your lifeline... Now you'll need diehard courage to dare look at its other side. Come on: this is just the right time, at very most.
items.name: Trump Card

items.description: This small ticket certifies that you have met the necessary requirements to receive what has been offered to you in exchange. Legend would even have you believe that this item could let you go to spectacular places...
items.name: Golden Ticket

items.description: With this ring on your finger, you can proudly assert your attachment to your customs, and demonstrate your colourful traditions. Come on, no one will judge you! Diversity is a requirement!
items.name: Folkloric Ring

items.description: They didn't live together happily ever after. And your responsibility in this ordeal is entirely confessed. Sometimes, some people just want to see the World of Twelve burn.
items.name: Cruelty Gem

items.description: Nothing seems to limit your kindness, altruism, and selflessness which define you. This seal honours you for your behaviour. But who might be in the shadows, taking advantage of your naivety?
items.name: Charity Jewel

items.description: Proudly wearing this jewel sets you apart from the boring old people: common ways disgust you, and major factions aren't for you. You find happiness where you're not expected, where commonplace regulars turn tail. Defending the shy voices of the assembly, the young and lost causes suits you much better.
items.name: Bohemian Signet Ring

items.description: A disciplined knight on the chessboard of Shariva's Favourites, you can recognise the importance of rules, and the truth which is hidden behind obedience. Your choice of the party of order was indeed noticed by who it may concern.
items.name: Seal of Authority

items.description: Tumult has burst into you, and this seal is the material evidence of it. It symbolises the link which unites you to Tumult's plans. No doubt things will now never again be the same as they were before: at least you will be able to parade your finger, adorned with this distinctive mark.
items.name: Mark of the Favourites

items.description: A letter for Amayiro, written by Steward San Lavalss. You, on the other hand, plan on giving it to Danathor. You could also burn it, but that would be frowned upon.
items.name: Letter from Steward San Lavalss

items.description: This looks and smells like marinated Porcos meat. You're almost tempted to check if it also has the same taste.
items.name: Benn Zeen's Unguent

items.description: The Dreggon Tamer has put all of his know-how into this Trap.
items.name: Crocodyl Trap

items.description: Capturing this unique specimen of Crocodyl was really a piece of croc.
items.name: Crosodyl

items.description: One of the five eggs laid by the goddess Araknas.
items.name: Araknas Sacred Stone

items.description: One of the five eggs laid by the goddess Araknas.
items.name: Araknas Sacred Stone

items.description: One of the five eggs laid by the goddess Araknas.
items.name: Araknas Sacred Stone

items.description: One of the five eggs laid by the goddess Araknas.
items.name: Araknas Sacred Stone

items.description: One of the five eggs laid by the goddess Araknas.
items.name: Araknas Sacred Stone

items.description: Various documents about the Araknas Sacred Stones have been compiled in this book, by Lars Tord.
items.name: Documents about the Araknas Sacred Stones

items.description: Ramoga has given you this key to free her friend, Lars Tord.
items.name: Cybworks' Hideout Key

items.description: It's no good shutting the stable door after the horse has bolted, but really, if the Cybwork had been more careful with his hardware, he wouldn't be so screwed over now.
items.name: Defective Cybwork Bolt

items.description: In the past, it was used to see the future in certain tribes' rites. The visions were always the same: regurgitating your last meal and changing your shoes.
items.name: Mush Mish Thallus

items.description: This envelope is to be given to Doctor Walter-Bychop's assistant.
items.name: Envelope for Aspic Farnswotte

items.description: This stone was dyed red after spending a day up the nose of an Enutrof who sniffed too hard.
items.name: Rikiki Gem

items.description: This marble wasn't the same colour when you picked it up, but is that really important?
items.name: Rikiki Marble

items.description: This is one of the blueprints King Allister chose to build a castle for his niece.
items.name: Princess Castle Blueprint

items.description: This castle is fragile and there is no guarantee it will be deceptive to the Collector, which is why you have your weapon as plan B.
items.name: Littls' Castle

items.description: Jerry Forj sold you these plans. Handymen can follow them, but they will need the following resources: 1 Pyrute, 1 Aquamarine, 15 Mandrakes and 1 Bluebell Stem.
items.name: King Leorictus's Crypt Key Recipe

items.description: It seems Alchemists are able to create an elixir that transforms the drinker into an Arachnee, using the following ingredients: 1 Big Phial, 1 Arachnee Leg, 1 Arak-hai Gland and 1 Drinking Water.
items.name: Arachnee Elixir Recipe

items.description: Funerary urns are very in-fashion hearth ornaments, and for good reason! Indeed, parents use them as a reason to slap their children when they knock over the ashes.
items.name: King Leorictus's Urn

items.description: Jerry Forj sold you these plans. Handymen can follow them, but they will need the following resources: 1 Pyrute, 1 Agathe, 15 Mandrakes and 1 Sulphur Pouch.
items.name: Prince Djamal Brecht's Crypt Key Recipe

items.description: Funerary urns are very in-fashion hearth ornaments, and for good reason! Indeed, parents use them as a reason to whip their children when they knock over the ashes.
items.name: Prince Djamal Brecht's Urn

items.description: Jon Burrowman suggests using the following resources: 1 Korriander Flower, 3 Fungore Gills, 2 Serpula Flakes, 35 Mandrakes, 10 Dolomite, 2 Nuggets, and 1 Sulphur Pouch.
items.name: Solvent Recipe

items.description: This book deals with the Petrified Forest and the location of one of the five Araknas Sacred Stones.
items.name: Book about the Petrified Forest

items.description: This document – signed by the gods and the Lord of the Demons, and whose text is as long as a short, extremely detailed abstract of the famous writer, poet and entertainer Aimee Gee – lists all the clauses prohibiting the demons from invading the world.
items.name: Non-Aggression Pact

items.description: Only experienced chefs are able to prepare the Astrub Kitchen Soup removing its taste of rotting flesh. To make it, you'll need 1 Drinking Water, 7 Mandrakes, 1 Spoiled Meat, 5 Onions, 5 Beans, 5 measures of salt and 1 Astrub Beer.
items.name: Astrub Kitchen Soup Recipe

items.description: Is its name suggests, this ruby is magical.
items.name: Magic Ruby

items.description: The complicated aspect of these tools is a guarantee of their quality.
items.name: Burglary Tools

items.description: Once completed, this talisman will protect you from the deathly cold spell that magically protects a place on Sakai.
items.name: Incomplete Dayvid Blayne's Talisman

items.description: This talisman is supposed to protect you from the deathly cold spell that magically protects a place on Sakai.
items.name: Dayvid Blayne's Talisman

items.description: This chest contains material that belonged to the Ice Goblins before you stole it.
items.name: Ice Goblin Material

items.description: This chest contains material that belonged to the Ice Goblins before you stole it.
items.name: Ice Goblin Material

items.description: This chest contains material that belonged to the Ice Goblins before you stole it.
items.name: Ice Goblin Material

items.description: It's heresy to use this hammer for anything other than advancing science. Smashing enemies' skulls can be classed in this category if it's done with a scientific goal.
items.name: Ereziah's Hammer

items.description: Ferdi McGellan predicted that you would no longer be able to enjoy his light throughout the whole day. After this period, you can go back to ask him yet more stupid questions.
items.name: Ferdi McGellan's Prediction

items.description: This ruby is imbued with the heat of a volcano, so you can use it as a hot water bottle or lantern.
items.name: Imbued Magic Ruby

items.description:
Due to budget restrictions, this item's description does not exist. You'll have to get by without it.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Araknas Sacred Stones User Guide

items.description: Making this key requires: 10 Mandrakes, 10 Millets, 10 Elm Wood, 10 Dolomites, 10 Tench and 1 Spoiled Meat.
items.name: Cursed Temple Key Recipe

items.description: The initials R.Z. are etched into the wood of this sand-incrusted lute.
items.name: Old Lute

items.description: The divers use underwater Fairyworks to report their position, call for help, or simply to party; this can be a source of confusion, but also of memorable surprises.
items.name: Sufokian Fairywork

items.description: This crystal seems to vibrate with suppressed energy, a bit like you every time you're dying to give you mother-in-law a good slap.
items.name: Mauve Crystal

items.description: If you don't know what to do with this pearl, you can exchange it for various rewards with Pink Tada, in the Palace of Sufokia. If you do know what to do with it, you can ignore this pointless description, and go on living your life.
items.name: Pearl of the Depths

items.description: When you touch this old parchment, you have a fleeting vision of a Twelvian crossing the ages until the end of the world... and yet it's just a bit of sheet music.
items.name: Organ Sheet Music

items.description: When you see the amount of debt, you ask yourself if you've chosen the right career to make a living.
items.name: IOU

items.description: These chests contain magnificent jewels.
items.name: Ransom Jewels

items.description: You're tempted to make a break for it with this crate tucked under your arm and live a nice life far from Sufokia.
items.name: Crate of Pearls of the Depths

items.description: You took these samples randomly.
items.name: Algae Sample

items.description: Progress seems to be synonymous with pollution, even for the Foggernauts. Isn't that unfortunate?
items.name: Aquatic Mercury

items.description: You took these samples randomly.
items.name: Algae Sample

items.description: You took these samples randomly.
items.name: Algae Sample

items.description: You took these samples randomly.
items.name: Algae Sample

items.description: You took these samples randomly.
items.name: Algae Sample

items.description: It's really not recommended to eat even the tiniest amount.
items.name: Toxic Liver

items.description: This seal belongs to the stranger who attacked you near Captain Meno's Ship.
items.name: Eliotrope Seal

items.description: According to Aurelia the Eliotrope, Wakfu is the energy of Creation. It's difficult to believe that this strange, bluish sand hides one of the greatest mysteries of the Krosmoz among its grains.
items.name: Wakfu Sand

items.description: This coral doesn't grow near the Submerged Relics, so it's quite rare to see it on seashell merchants' stands. To get some, you'd better get your diving suit wet and look for it yourself.
items.name: Opalin Coral

items.description: All you need to do is find out where to insert this key, and you'll be able to enter Leanor's Sanctuary! There's no telling what you'll find in there.
items.name: Leanor's Sanctuary Key

items.description:
A long time spent in saltwater has damaged this book's pages, making them impossible to decipher. Such a shame – you won't be able to dive into reading them.
(You can still double-click it if you want to satisfy your curiosity, but that's just because you are who you are)
items.name: Soggy Book

items.description: This skeleton key has seen many a lock... If you use it to burgle honest people's houses, it's more likely to be the inside of a cell that you'll be seeing.
items.name: Rooky's Lockpick

items.description: This receipt certifies that Pink Tada gave you a Fear-Catcher in exchange for an Angular Stone. An honest trader would carefully put it away with their account books; as for you, you can just throw it on the fire.
items.name: Pink Tada's Receipt

items.description: As you contemplate this work of art, you suddenly have a deep feeling of unease. Whoever carved such a statuette must have trouble sleeping at night.
items.name: Abominable Statuette

items.description:
Is this item a kitchen utensil? A key? A terrifying weapon? A Skt-Zo baby rattle? You have no idea whatsoever.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Unspeakable Item

items.description: You are now the happy owner of a brain. It was about time.
items.name: Professor Nomis's Tank

items.description: This starfish was leisurely going about its business, when you flattened it like a pancake. What have you done to save the world? You could have found a better cop-out.
items.name: Venerable Starfish

items.description: Even though you were involved in creating this magical sign of great power, you have difficulty making anything out on it besides a bulging eye stuck to a stunted starfish.
items.name: Sign of the Very Old Ancients

items.description: An ancient evil seems to haunt this shell... unless it's simply an awful hermit crab of the depths.
items.name: Abyssal Shell

items.description: Rykke Zane met a tragic end. By letting him rest among his own, you'll be carrying out a good deed. That's rare enough to be saluted.
items.name: Rykke Zane's Remains

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: This grass stuck to your diving suit isn't terribly useful.
items.name: Aquatic Grass

items.description: The Chaplain's Pendant was broken during combat. As Johan Gusstafen pointed out, it looks like a Hulhu idol, but its eyes can't see a thing. Rumour has it that an idol specialist has arrived in Amakna – she can probably help you to make a functioning Hulhu idol.
items.name: Chaplain's Pendant

items.description: Cut your eyes at this thing! Oh wait, looks like someone already did...
items.name: Ambusher Spookkoth's Eye

items.description: This contract, signed by a certain Schubert, mentions the bonus the Merkaptans will receive once they've sabotaged the archaeologists' submarine.
items.name: Merkaptans' Contract

items.description: The surface of this tablet conserves outlines drawn on it, then erases itself at the tap of a ruler. Oh, if only all of the mistakes you've made were written on a Technomagical Slate, you could make them disappear in the blink of an eye! That'd be practical... Alas, they're set in stone, instead.
items.name: Technomagical Slate

items.description: Yet another enigmatic item made by the Servants of the Unspeakable; its purpose remains a mystery.
items.name: Enigmatic Item

items.description: The properties of this mineral remain a mystery to the Foggernauts. But they've found out that keeping some on them lets them disappear permanently if a Skt-Zo happens to be nearby.
items.name: Toklium Ore

items.description: This brain weighs more in the open air than in the water. That explains why the Trituns are smarter than they look.
items.name: Tritun Brain

items.description: Not to be confused with a jawncnidocyst, the Buba Cnidocyst resembles a Protoz'orror Cell loaded with virulent toxins.
items.name: Buba Cnidocyst

items.description: This bit of metal comes from a damaged turret.
items.name: Copper Metal

items.description: You have to be really perverse to dare to eat the flesh of a sentient creature. It's a real kick in the face to Kanniball traditions.
items.name: Tritun Leg

items.description: This page is unreadable not only because it endured a long stay at the bottom of the ocean, but also because it's written in an unknown language.
items.name: Unreadable Page

items.description: This flesh decomposes rapidly in the open air, which makes it a bit difficult to use in cooking. It also explains the odour permeating certain Sufokian taverns.
items.name: Aquatic Flesh

items.description: There are mysterious arabesque symbols engraved on this key that are difficult to make out and seem to be constantly changing. A simple optical illusion, or the first signs of madness?
items.name: Silver Key

items.description: At first glance, this ring isn't much to look at. But it seems that a powerful sorcerer managed to trap Hawo'Gadas'So, a Shushu of the worst kind, inside it.
items.name: Stone Ring

items.description: They're as fragile as soap bubbles, so you have to handle them carefully.
items.name: Iridescent Globes

items.description: You managed to create this... this thing, but we're not quite sure how.
items.name: Protoplasmic Flesh

items.description: Although this tentacle and its owner have long since been separated, it continues to move as much as a toddler who's been told they can't have any candy.
items.name: Agitated Tentacle

items.description: Yet another useless item in your inventory! Luckily, these bandages should disintegrate quickly.
items.name: Damp Bandages

items.description: Sticking these hairs to your glasses won't give you the gift of second sight. Sticking them elsewhere will keep you warm in winter though.
items.name: Visionary Mage Hairs

items.description: Anyone who's tempted to consume the meat from this shell will probably end up in the loony bin. Is that the reason you don't come across many people of sound mind in Rygurgal? Maybe... You may never know...
items.name: Rygurgal Shell

items.description: This item, which can stick to even the smoothest walls, has a rather disquieting gaze. It's as if it can see into the depths of your soul to explore all the dark recesses and find the worst aspects.
items.name: Eye of Ansoh

items.description: Their tridents let Trydes turn invisible: it seems that it acts on the surrounding water in such a way as to make it divert all visible light.
items.name: Cracked Trident

items.description: Their tridents let Trydes turn invisible: it seems that it acts on the surrounding water in such a way as to make it divert all visible light.
items.name: Cracked Trident

items.description: Their tridents let Trydes turn invisible: it seems that it acts on the surrounding water in such a way as to make it divert all visible light.
items.name: Chief Tryde's Trident

items.description: Ideal for hiding your face and passing yourself off as someone else.
items.name: Black Star Suit

items.description: These Technomagical Slates are full of information for the Trituns.
items.name: Victor Schubert's Documents

items.description: The stone tablets used by the Trituns are extremely heavy out of the water.
items.name: Chest of Tablets

items.description: For delicate noses, the smell coming from this Grawn is unbearable. For true lovers of the sea, it's even worse. In other words: hold your nose, unless you want to keel over.
items.name: Centenarian Grawn

items.description: Fhtagn!
items.name: P'Koutoulou Ch'ton

items.description: Fhtagn!
items.name: P'Koutoulou Zothoth

items.description: Fhtagn!
items.name: P'Koutoulou Glaakiph

items.description: A haphazard mix of creature parts gave this result.
items.name: Unspeakable Mixture

items.description: As powerful as it is ancient, this tiny creature is trying to reestablish its dominance over beings larger than itself.
items.name: Koutoulou Moth

items.description: The feathers on this sad specimen are long gone, but you can always use it as a riding crop at one of the masked parties you're always pretending you don't go to.
items.name: Gobvious's Damp Feather

items.description: You hesitate to replace the text of this Technomagical Slate with drawings of Bow Meows and Unikrons.
items.name: Purchase Order

items.description: Deks's Assistant should find what he's looking for in this crate. If only finding a girlfriend were so easy...
items.name: Crate of Spare Parts

items.description: This Sheet Metal Fragment can be used to build a house, make a barbecue, as a shield... the possibilities are limited only by its user's imagination.
items.name: Sheet Metal Fragment

items.description: Tritun skin, combined with their natural ability to swim, lets them make it through certain underwater passages that they alone can make it through. It's not well understood how that works.
items.name: Cracked Tritun Skin

items.description:
This purse contains alitons.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Flat Purse of Alitons

items.description:
This purse contains alitons.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Soft Purse of Alitons

items.description:
This purse contains alitons.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Dry Purse of Alitons

items.description:
This purse contains alitons.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Stuffed Purse of Alitons

items.description:
This purse contains alitons.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Full Purse of Alitons

items.description: Although this Bliblitch spent its existence teleporting from one place to another, it now seems to stay where it is. What's most surprising is the almost pristine state of its carcass. It would seem that whoever took its life put their heart and soul into the task.
items.name: Intact Bliblitch Carcass

items.description: This sheet music, from some distant era, seems to have been perfectly preserved thanks to a Bliblitch's gastric juices. From what little of it you understand, its content is boring at best. It was quite happy where it was.
items.name: Unknown Sheet Music

items.description: The Bliblitch who swallowed this abacus to help with its accounting problems probably wasn't counting on it. The result? It got its money's worth.
items.name: Rusty Abacus

items.description: It looks like you can put this heavy chain around your neck to look classy, in the hope that others won't look down their nose at you. But you can't really change the past.
items.name: Tacky Chain

items.description: It's said that a very long time ago, people threw balls like this on a small patch of gravel, on the pretext of doing sport. On closer inspection, they must have thought to remove this cylindrical protrusion so the ball could roll better...
items.name: Deformed Metal Ball

items.description: This concentrated substance gives off the virility of a Bliblitch trying to distinguish himself from the others during mating season. If you get any on you, you risk getting noticed by your peers for many weeks to come...
items.name: Bliblitch Musk

items.description: This seed developed an unusual resistance, thanks to the environment in which it grew. Mixed with the right ingredients, it can protect anything from the ravages of time.
items.name: Timeless Cania Seed

items.description: This timeless hair keeps its colour, ignoring the years that pass by. Unusually long, it stays straight even in the most humid environments.
items.name: Francis Lalande's Hair

items.description: This amulet is truly pleasing: it's made to conceal the ravages of time, is is timelessly classy. Wear it tomorrow, today, yesterday... for those who wear it, time is merely a matter of perspective.
items.name: Passing Amulet

items.description: When a goblin decides to brood, it's difficult to turn them around. Best wait until it passes. Anyway, after a minute, they'll have already forgotten all about it.
items.name: Brooding Goblin

items.description: A goblin's horoscope is supposed to be written on this piece of parchment, but to you, it's nothing but gibberish.
items.name: Grubby Parchment

items.description: Go and see the Superstitious Goblin to get the answers to the questions which appear on this form.
items.name: Astrological Questionnaire

items.description: Go back and see Yova Etna to show her the questionnaire.
items.name: Filled-in Astrological Questionnaire

items.description: All that's left for you to do is show this horoscope to the Superstitious Goblin. With a bit of luck, he'll leave without further ado.
items.name: Horoscope certified by Yova Etna

items.description: Yova Etna has asked you to think before talking to her again. A strange concept for you, of course, but you'll get used to it.
items.name: Moment of Thought

items.description: According to the Sram you saw near the Trool Fair, these dice should allow you to beat the Playful Goblin at 421. All that's left for you to do is hope you haven't been swindled.
items.name: Loaded Dice

items.description: This slightly disgusting thing could be of some interest to a certain Collector Goblin.
items.name: Old Whine-Gumm

items.description: This slightly disgusting thing could be of some interest to a certain Collector Goblin.
items.name: Old Whine-Gumm

items.description: This slightly disgusting thing could be of some interest to a certain Collector Goblin.
items.name: Old Whine-Gumm

items.description: This slightly disgusting thing could be of some interest to a certain Collector Goblin.
items.name: Old Whine-Gumm

items.description: You did this goblin in nicely. But did you really need its skin too?
items.name: Belligerent Goblin Skin

items.description: Here's a nice stone.
items.name: Cania Cracklered Stone

items.description: This cape, made of Plains Larva Skin, has an amazing finish, and would befit a child beautifully. You need but wear it to release your inner larva and spend days wriggling about on the floor.
items.name: Coquette Plains Cape

items.description: This larva skin is of relative size, because when all's said and done, it's quite small.
items.name: Large Plains Larva Skin

items.description: Some people believe that this simple-looking shell can actually murmur unconfessed secrets and reveal truths capable of changing lives... but always in the form of the sound of the sea.
items.name: Shell of Murmurs

items.description: Created by the brothers Bill & Kall, this cord is able to tie elements together which can't generally be tied together. Used with the right materials, it will make any object that can be used by a child indestructible.
items.name: Bill & Kall Cord

items.description: This bag contains – among other things – medicinal plants.
items.name: Natasha Manka's Bag

items.description: For some unknown reason, Crobaks particularly like this wood.
items.name: Crobak Wood

items.description: For some unknown reason, Crobaks particularly like this wood.
items.name: Crobak Wood

items.description: For some unknown reason, Crobaks particularly like this wood.
items.name: Crobak Wood

items.description: This item's nothing like the magical sticks that many male charlatans boast about owning.
items.name: Enchanted Stick

items.description: This letter is addressed to Yova Etna, the clairvoyant.
items.name: Letter from Natasha Manka

items.description: Yova Etna has written down her analysis and recommendations for Natasha Manka.
items.name: Letter from Yova Etna

items.description: Available in limited edition, this guide contains all the information you'll need to acquaint yourself with the secrets of dominion and indoctrinating a group of friends.
items.name: Lord Crow's Guide

items.description: This pouch contains a few pieces of metal, a handful of weirdly-shaped dice, and a pencil with a rubber on the end; all of them are size XXXL.
items.name: Giant Suspicious Pouch

items.description: You have to have a damned strong stomach and heart to hope to survive a mouthful of this Troofle.
items.name: Krosmic Troofle

items.description: With this trophy, you remind everyone that it's always the strongest who are right.
items.name: Maelstrool Shoulder Pad

items.description: Very respectful of their environment, the Imps have got into the habit of designing their automatons using biodegradable and recyclable materials. As a result, it became quite feasible to destroy a neighbour's creation in order to improve their own.
items.name: Experimental Automaton Fragments

items.description: Despite their childish looks, Imps don't choose their components lightly: this bolt was smelted in one of the most famous forges in the World of Twelve, and can kill more than a man if used correctly.
items.name: Bolt in Good Condition

items.description: This unit lets things which shouldn't make noises make noises. Sometimes, these noises get interpreted as speech, but overall, they're still quite unpleasant to listen to.
items.name: Synthetic Communication Unit

items.description: This potion's effects are strange, but phenomenally powerful.
items.name: Resurrection Potion

items.description: Brings back memories buried within whoever drinks it.
items.name: Memory Potion

items.description: A small amount of this serum is enough to transform an enraged Bow Wow into a sweet little doggie.
items.name: Paxifik Serum

items.description: The best way to cook it is to roast it in its own fat.
items.name: Strich Leg

items.description: Documents detailing the Brakmarian convoys' goods and schedule.
items.name: Contraband Documents

items.description: This hard-to-get document certifies that your automaton works perfectly.
items.name: Technical Check Certificate

items.description: This torn and illegible document is stamped with the seal of Brakmar.
items.name: Brakmarian Scroll

items.description: Ave Centura has given you these sheets in order to quickly note down clues you might find. It's tempting to draw genitals on it, but the time's no joke.
items.name: Pile of Sheets

items.description: The first clue you've found has been very awkwardly drawn on paper. It almost looks like the work of a child, and a one-armed one at that.
items.name: First Clue

items.description: Despite the poor quality of the first clue, this one shows no signs of progress in terms of image quality.
items.name: Second Clue

items.description: This fish has spent far too much time exposed to the blazing sun and sandy winds. It smells as good as a dish that's been inadvertently forgotten in a closet for several years.
items.name: Fishticky

items.description: This lolly looks like at least two people have already sucked it. But who would do such a thing?
items.name: Stolen Lolly

items.description: This shovel must have sentimental value, because kisses can be seen on the shaft.
items.name: Stolen Shovel

items.description: This strange machine seems to analyse the sand and reveal its origin.
items.name: Snyflor

items.description: It looks like Spice, it tastes like Spice, but this isn't Spice.
items.name: Modified Spice

items.description: This crate has been in the blazing sunshine for so long, the apples inside are now more like dry cake than juicy fruit.
items.name: Crate of Apis

items.description: This bone can be distinguished from others by the strange aura it gives off. It's quite probably a lucky bone... Or a jinx bone, but fortunately, they're a lot rarer.
items.name: Lucky Bone

items.description: This strong liquor – probably traditionally-made – gives off a strong smell.
items.name: Bottle of Strong Liquor

items.description: Max is under the effects of the tranquiliser Shool Suk gave you. Take Max to him while you find a solution to cure him.
items.name: Rad Max

items.description: This small key allows you to access the confidential messages saved in the Fogger self-defence turrets, even without owning the original access codes. It's said that a certain Enhessa is responsible for their design.
items.name: Foggernaut Decryption Key

items.description: Thanks to this badge, you'll find the members of the Umphialla Corporation in Ohwymi more willing to cooperate.
items.name: Sarakech Badge

items.description: Living or dead, Leopenas always have glassy eyes.
items.name: Glassy Leopena Eye

items.description: This letter is addressed to scientists studying the effects of Spice on local wildlife. Trying to open it without being the recipient would cause intense pain and perhaps even premature death.
items.name: Benedict Gesser's Instructions

items.description: You took great care in taking this sample.
items.name: Mantiscore Sample

items.description: These documents contain all the information about a future exchange between the Umphialla Corporation and independent Spice researchers.
items.name: Fake Corporation Documents

items.description: This underwear reminds you why abusing hearts can kill love.
items.name: Bill Lelong's Underpants

items.description: Dipped in glue and then hung on the end of a string, these underpants will make an excellent flytrap.
items.name: Windsor Tolero's Underpants

items.description: Concocted from a fish which was already quite gamy, then chewed fervently in someone's jaws, this viscous preparation will unblock your nose, and then some.
items.name: Icky Preparation

items.description: Extremely sturdy glasses that can protect you from sand storms.
items.name: Pair of Glasses

items.description: Obtained after a marriage ceremony between two people who loved each other dearly, regardless of their species or origin.
items.name: Quintessence of True Love

items.description:
Using it in the air will produce a sound that'd scare anyone, including your mother-in-law.
(Double-click to use the whip in front of Cactool.)
items.name: Powerful Whip

items.description: This hastily-written letter is as badly-written as your last essay.
items.name: Letter from Dagmar Shall

items.description: Contrary to its name, this bag doesn't contain the remains of bandits and other scoundrels.
items.name: Bag of Rubbish

items.description: Based on your investigator experience: A testimony report, or observations of a Saguaro's defence capabilities.
items.name: Saguaro Observation Notes

items.description: Based on your investigator experience: A testimony report, or observations of a Cactana's defence capabilities.
items.name: Cactana Observation Notes

items.description: Based on your investigator experience: A testimony report, or observations of a Pampastuc's defence capabilities.
items.name: Pampastuc Observation Notes

items.description: Retrieved from an abomination of the desert, this rock looks like charcoal, but heavier and harder.
items.name: Abominable Rock

items.description: This stone block is as heavy as it looks.
items.name: Big Stone Block

items.description: Contract stating an agreement to purchase goods.
items.name: Contract

items.description: A sample obtained in a cave near the Mastodon Cemetery.
items.name: Strange Water Sample

items.description: This is a variant of the tool invented by the Ice Goblins to collect frozen boogers.
items.name: Bone-Sampling Tool

items.description: This fairly old bone fragment was taken from a rib of one of the gigantic skeletons of Ohwymi. Taking it with you is a bit like stealing a paving slab from one of the streets of Bonta to take it home as a souvenir.
items.name: Bony Rib Sample

items.description: This piece of bone was detached from the huge supposed femur in a pile of Mastodon bones. But it won't get you very far.
items.name: Bony Femur Sample

items.description: The spine from which this sample was taken was so big that it served as a refuge for desert animals. By taking this fragment to Mayko Zouzoo, you're depriving them of a piece of their roof.
items.name: Bony Spine Sample

items.description: This substance was sampled from deep inside an imposing Mastodon's vertebra. It will probably reveal their cause of death.
items.name: Bony Vertebra Sample

items.description: This strange liquid comes straight from the inside the tusk of an ancient Mastodon. Its colour is both hypnotic and pleasant to look at.
items.name: Bony Tusk Sample

items.description: This sample is the result of a laborious excavation of a mastodon's kneecap. It may contain the answer to many mysteries of the past.
items.name: Bony Kneecap Sample

items.description: This flask contains a concentrate of different substances contained within the samples taken in the Mastodon Cemetery. It must be analysed by a specialist in order to know how it could have triggered the extinction of these giant beasts.
items.name: Strange Substance

items.description: This local beverage is a real tradition among Castucs. However, they've had hundreds of years to allow their bodies to get used to it, and many Twelvians might lose several years if they try to drink it.
items.name: Castuc Liquor

items.description: Not recommended for vegetarians, this kibble has unsuspected virtues.
items.name: Spiced Kibble

items.description: Looks like a strange mix of spells and card game rules.
items.name: Pokerhoyle's Incomplete Writings

items.description: This tooth came detached from Mayko Zouzoo's jaw when he bumped heads with a Leopena, after jumping on it. That'll probably remind him forever more that you shouldn't drink just anything, at risk of doing just about anything.
items.name: Broken Tooth

items.description:
Fabulous treasure, certain death, or both? Who knows where this map will lead you?
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Buck Ster's Map

items.description: Contract stating an agreement to purchase goods.
items.name: Signed Contract

items.description: These wooden daggers are engraved with the initials DC.
items.name: Worn Daggers

items.description: So you don't frighten strangers, you are advised not to wear this g-string to the Captain Chafer Panty Party.
items.name: Casterror G-String

items.description: A reminder of your rage, which prioritizes aggression over discussion.
items.name: Saguaro Blood Lust

items.description: A reminder of your rage, which prioritizes aggression over discussion.
items.name: Cactana Blood Lust

items.description: A reminder of your rage, which prioritizes aggression over discussion.
items.name: Pampastuc Blood Lust

items.description: This chest contains material to bore a passage into the rock.
items.name: Ogolli Shog's Chest

items.description: This chest contains something expensive on the black market.
items.name: Chest for Spice Dikoune

items.description: Useful for walking, this stick is even more useful for beating people.
items.name: Ming Swi Pul Walking Pole

items.description: The burning of this rock fragment releases wreaths of blue smoke resembling distorted faces. It produces a sound similar to screams of pain.
items.name: Spectral Rock Fragment

items.description: This orange's acidity enhances the taste of chillies. Suffice to say, this makes it burn even more.
items.name: Pikmama's Orange

items.description: Dipping your lips into this dish will make you spit fire like Ignemikahl. Swallowing a mouthful will burn your gullet.
items.name: Ohwymi Chili Dish

items.description: Common Grains of Sand.
items.name: Grains of Sand

items.description: Common Grains of Sand.
items.name: Grains of Sand

items.description: Common Grains of Sand.
items.name: Grains of Sand

items.description: This beer smells of sweat, and no desert in the world could convince you to drink it.
items.name: Ohwymi Adulterated Beer

items.description: At best, these very broad wings will make whoever wears them glide.
items.name: Intact Red Scaraleaf Wings

items.description: At best, these very broad wings will make whoever wears them glide.
items.name: Intact Blue Scaraleaf Wings

items.description: At best, these very broad wings will make whoever wears them glide.
items.name: Intact White Scaraleaf Wings

items.description: At best, these very broad wings will make whoever wears them glide.
items.name: Intact Green Scaraleaf Wings

items.description: This potion will make you thirsty. Very thirsty. Not to be consumed near taverns, to avoid emptying your purse.
items.name: Potion of Intense Thirst

items.description: This rubber duck will be of highly significant use in your bathtub. Aside from that, you're still not sure what use it will be.
items.name: Rubber Duck

items.description: This sword won't cut through anything. It's amazingly gentle, and even a child couldn't hurt themself with it.
items.name: Harmlessword

items.description: Extremely light, this ball and chain wouldn't slow anyone down. It also floats lightly just above the ground.
items.name: Useless Ball and Chain

items.description: This stuffed toy shouldn't be handled by just anyone, and certainly not by children. Its owner must have dropped a can of itching powder on it.
items.name: Itchy Stuffed Toy

items.description: This gift box is completely empty. You ask yourself who could have offered someone a gift like this.
items.name: Empty Gift

items.description: This candle can only be lit in daylight and outdoors. Such a shame for such an item.
items.name: Daylight Candle

items.description: This is a pot of aging cream which adds twenty years to your skin. Fortunately, the effect isn't permanent, and usually disappears within two decades.
items.name: Aging Cream

items.description: This bag contains a few pods of a rare Spice. Contrary to what I heard, it doesn't give food a bad taste to foods, but to whomever consumes it.
items.name: Bag of Spice of Bad Taste

items.description: This book isn't very interesting. It contains nothing but a single, repeated phrase from start to end: "A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush."
items.name: Brilliant Book

items.description: Quite simply, the Asse Sea Starfish reduced to powder. Creating it is relatively simple, and consists of repeatedly hitting the starfish. Be careful not to get any in your eyes, though – it stings!
items.name: Starfish Trooper Powder

items.description: This is a simple bag containing everything needed to go fishing. Earthworms wriggle around happily at the bottom of the bag.
items.name: Fishing Bag

items.description: This bread is made only by Dark Bakers, who guard their secret recipe jealously. In any case, nobody would want any; it emanates an aura of rife banditry, which must be particularly indigestible.
items.name: Dark Bread

items.description: This Dark Bread is soaked with Discordesque potion, which makes it the perfect spark to set off an explosive fight.
items.name: Discordesque Bread

items.description: A very special flavour for jam. It's not for everyone.
items.name: Mint Jam

items.description: A rather normal flavour for jam.
items.name: Strawberry Jam

items.description: A strange, bluish mixture.
items.name: Blue Jam

items.description: This richly decorated stuffed toy probably belonged to an important merchant's child. On its belly, you can see a label, on which the brand "Allkuddli™" is written.
items.name: Allkuddli Stuffed Toy

items.description: This sceptre is probably the classiest and most upmarket tool to scratch your back with. Ensures dignity in all circumstances.
items.name: Back-Scratcher Sceptre

items.description: This item is probably one of the most beautiful you've seen in your life. Holding it in your hands, you feel an aura of joy and happiness wash over you.
items.name: Ama Ankh

items.description: The key radiates the same force as the greenhouse lock, and you immediately understand that they're made for each other. Unless it's the other way around...
items.name: Greenhouse Key

items.description: An indispensable tool for any self-respecting archaeologist. Used correctly, it lets you quickly break rock, whereas before it'd have taken you years with a toothbrush.
items.name: Dynamite

items.description: This detonator will allow you to light an explosive. Also works at parties, if you're a good dancer.
items.name: Detonator

items.description: A strong rope made from old mummy bandages. It smells of dirty old socks, forgotten under someone's bed.
items.name: Bandage Rope

items.description: Its inventor kept screaming "the deader you are, the stronger you are". He was killed trying to be the best guitarist in the world. Nobody knows how it happened, and no linking theory has been confirmed since.
items.name: Experimental Flamethrower

items.description: Higher, farther, stronger.
items.name: Climbing Equipment

items.description: Some products are such life-changers that they make you ask: "Why didn't someone invent that sooner?"
items.name: Magic Ball

items.description: The Wurmlord has poured his venom on you. After what you put him through, let's hope his liver's still working.
items.name: Digestive Juice

items.description: The best way to learn is to repeat over and over again.
items.name: Bandijd Bandage

items.description: You found this key in the belly of a Voracious Tremrus. Clearly, Sandworms are like Gobballs: they really will swallow anything.
items.name: Sand-Encrusted Key

items.description: A few pages written by Ahon, a Taur scholar who was also a lighthouse guardian. Maybe he wanted to enlighten the world with his knowledge?
items.name: Ahon's Journal

items.description: A sweetish smell emanates from the red powder contained within this box, but make no mistake: this Spice is not made for delicate palates.
items.name: Spice Box

items.description: This seal will allow you to permanently close the magic portal opened by Jhessica.
items.name: Closure Seal

items.description:
According to Rimanda, the incantation written on this scroll will allow you to make a Huppermage Symbol appear at the center of the Cursed Pyramid.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Rimanda's Scroll

items.description: Get rid of this spark as soon as possible, otherwise you're going to set fire to the powder.
items.name: Spark of Energy

items.description: Subelba needs parts for his new models of Siever.
items.name: Siever Spare Parts

items.description:
This box contains a Siever with reinforced armour-plating. It was developed by Subelba.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Experimental Siever Prototype

items.description:
This box contains a silent Siever, developed by Subelba.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: New Experimental Siever Prototype

items.description:
This box contains a Siever which emits a repulsive field. It was developed by Subelba.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Final Experimental Siever Prototype

items.description: A document describing the events of the disappearance of the greenery around the Forgotten City of Ohwymi.
items.name: Ohwymi Historical Document

items.description: The plants these seeds come from completely disappeared long ago. To be used carefully, due to their rarity.
items.name: Ohwymi Plant Seeds

items.description: You'll need sand to place this Piece of Masonry, and you may just find some in Ohwymi...
items.name: Piece of Masonry

items.description: This mushroom lost its luminescence when you picked it. That's probably because you're not a luminary.
items.name: Ohwymi Mushroom

items.description: This vine isn't long enough for you to swing from the end of it and pretend to be a lord of the jungle.
items.name: Vine Fragment

items.description: As this old debris goes to show (don't get angry, I'm not referring to you), many convoys trying to cross the Gorge of Howling Winds never reach their destination.
items.name: Cart Debris

items.description: This contraption is as mysterious as it is reliable. It doesn't work every time, but its potential is incredible, and it guides anyone who knows how to use it with a smooth voice. It is often referred to as a GPS, for Girl of Pretty Speech.
items.name: Mystical Detector

items.description: Dries everything with unparalleled absorption.
items.name: Ambush Mummy Bandage

items.description: Keeping bits of dead animals in your bag is not the best way to make friends.
items.name: Sharcut Remains

items.description: A flower which is as alive as the guardian from which it comes.
items.name: Ohwymi Red Flower

items.description: That's one Mastifang that won't bug you any more.
items.name: Mastifang Remains

items.description: The quintessence of a Wind Elemental.
items.name: Wind Elemental Orb

items.description: Idarfen has asked you to give this amulet to Chanisa.
items.name: Corporation Amulet

items.description: They smell just as bad as the retirement home where you sent your grandparents.
items.name: Sandworm Entrails

items.description: These bandages are as old as their owner, and he as old as his bandages. Over time, they became infused with his magical powers, but also his smell of rotting flesh.
items.name: Cursed Bandages

items.description: Losing your tail like that, it's got to be infuriating.
items.name: Enraged Boowolf Tail

items.description: Bow Meows sharpen their claws on couches, while Boowolves sharpen them on passing adventurers... at the risk of losing one here or there.
items.name: Enraged Boowolf Claws

items.description: If you're trying to calm an Enraged Boowolf, one of the first things you should do is make sure it's not a toothache that's upsetting them. Make very sure.
items.name: Enraged Boowolf Tooth

items.description: Get rid of this useless thing as soon as you get the chance.
items.name: Piece of Shell

items.description: Despite their low value, Grampa Muscle is collecting these fragments and he's offering an Ice Kama to anyone who brings him ten of them.
items.name: Kama Fragment

items.description: Whatever form it takes, a Gobgob tends to slobber... too bad if it's on your clothes. Don't worry: it dries quickly.
items.name: Gobgob Slobber

items.description: Whatever form it takes, a Gobgob tends to slobber... too bad if it's on your clothes. Don't worry: it dries quickly.
items.name: Gobgob Slobber

items.description: These provisions should help you hold out on your trip, assuming it doesn't last forever.
items.name: Crate of Provisions

items.description: Once stuffed, this corpse will make a nice hat stand. Until then, it makes an excellent fly trap.
items.name: Leo Strich Corpse

items.description: You can shake this vial as much as you like; there's not much risk of anything more serious than a cramp or tendonitis.
items.name: Sleeping Gas Vial

items.description: This head seems to be missing something...
items.name: Bodyless Head

items.description: This sword can decapitate anything and everything. Melons, bottles of champagne, the queen of hearts, acorn heads... nothing's safe from its sharp blade.
items.name: Vorpal Sword

items.description: You might get mistaken for a Chassullier if you get stopped by the Lousy Pigs.
items.name: Gun and Ammunition

items.description: Although it's probably less dangerous than your mother's rolling pin, this club is no less effective for knocking out an enemy.
items.name: Chassullier Club

items.description: Thanks to this Bow Meow Carrier you can transport your best friend without any risks. It won't yowl and will keep quiet for the entire trip.
items.name: Bow Meow Carrier

items.description: Since the Bow Meow Carrier is not suitable for transporting all manner of creature, you'll have to find a substitute.
items.name: Transport Cage

items.description: A petition to authorise the use of these darts on children has been signed by most of the parents in Astrub.
items.name: Tranquiliser Dart

items.description: Since the Bow Meow Carrier is not suitable for transporting all manner of creature, you'll have to find a substitute.
items.name: Occupied Transport Cage

items.description: Thanks to this Bow Meow Carrier you can transport your best friend without any risks. It won't yowl and will keep quiet for the entire trip.
items.name: Haunau Bow Meow Carrier

items.description:
This contract, taken from a Hunter, shows that he and a handful of others were hired to take live animals to a laboratory installed on the island.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Work Contract

items.description: This feather comes from one of Umphialla Corporation's animal experimentation laboratories.
items.name: Feather

items.description: This feather comes from one of Umphialla Corporation's animal experimentation laboratories.
items.name: Feather

items.description: This feather comes from one of Umphialla Corporation's animal experimentation laboratories.
items.name: Feather

items.description: There's a legend that if you drop this pebble from a high enough building, it will fall fast enough to penetrate someone's skull, but the story was definitively disproved by the LegendSmashers.
items.name: Golden Pebble

items.description: There are some who wipe with their hands in order to give some extra taste to their meals when they eat with their fingers. Others use their pets in order to mark their animal with their scent and establish dominance. Hunters decided to go with this cheap toilet paper that smears as much as it wipes.
items.name: Toilet Paper

items.description: Why do Buckshots hunt with Bags of Feathers on them?
items.name: Bag of Feathers

items.description: Even if it's a fake, you can't help feel a bit satisfied to be dragging a banker around town.
items.name: Stuffed Banker

items.description:
Just like Iop fighting guides, this textbook has plenty of images, but not much text.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Textbook

items.description: These remains look particularly appetising.
items.name: Jayhem's Remains

items.description: You brought a little souvenir with you, but you're not sure you should keep it.
items.name: Count Razof's Hair

items.description: This crate contains numerous textbooks that belong to Mishell.
items.name: Crate of Textbooks

items.description: A few drops of this liqueur are enough to put the drinker deep asleep.
items.name: Rod's Liqueur

items.description: This bottle ought to help you draw the Hunters down a false trail.
items.name: Exposed Bottle of Nottlebeck

items.description: This bottle ought to help you draw the Hunters down a false trail.
items.name: Dusty Bottle of Nottlebeck

items.description: This bottle ought to help you draw the Hunters down a false trail.
items.name: Uncorked Bottle of Nottlebeck

items.description:
This disguise will let you disguise yourself as a Crambo. Careful; it gets damaged easily.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Crambo Disguise

items.description: This artisanal beer, whose production secrets are known only to the initiated, has the power to reunite hunters, both good and bad.
items.name: Corked Bottle of Nottlebeck

items.description: Since the Bow Meow Carrier is not suitable for transporting all manner of creature, you'll have to find a substitute.
items.name: Broken Transport Cage

items.description: Contaminated Fungus Remains.
items.name: Fungus Remains

items.description: This gill is of no use.
items.name: Fungus Gill

items.description: This gill is of no use.
items.name: Fungus Gill

items.description: This gill is of no use.
items.name: Fungus Gill

items.description: This gill is of no use.
items.name: Fungus Gill

items.description: This gill is of no use.
items.name: Fungus Gill

items.description: This gill is of no use.
items.name: Fungus Gill

items.description:
You can read the following words on this message fragment:
...and don't forget to head...
items.name: Torn Message Fragment

items.description:
You can read the following words on this message fragment:
...head to you know where, by...
items.name: Torn Message Fragment

items.description:
You can read the following words on this message fragment:
...by taking the passage in...
items.name: Torn Message Fragment

items.description: This sample was collected from the imposing mushrooms that can be found in the Sidimote Moors. Are they edible? The only way to find out is to taste one. However, if the answer is no, you won't be around to find out.
items.name: Sample of Mushroom

items.description: This sample was collected from the fungi that can be found in the Sidimote Moors. The question is not finding out whether they're edible or not, but whether you really want to eat a piece of fungus.
items.name: Sample of Fungus

items.description: A Short Bone will never go far because, unlike a long bone, an Ouginak doesn't need help picking it up in their mouth.
items.name: Short Bone

items.description: A Short Bone will never go far because, unlike a long bone, an Ouginak doesn't need help picking it up in their mouth.
items.name: Short Bone

items.description: A Short Bone will never go far because, unlike a long bone, an Ouginak doesn't need help picking it up in their mouth.
items.name: Short Bone

items.description: This bone's owner should sit still for a while.
items.name: Killjoy Bone

items.description: To craft Erzal's beverage, an alchemist will need an Atolmond beer, five five-leaf clovers and a Draugr Chafer jaw.
items.name: Erzal's Beverage Formula

items.description: According to these documents, the mercenaries have been hired by a miner who wants to set up some drilling sites in the Enchanted Lakes. They were tasked with creating a powerful poison to contaminate the water, in order to encourage the Koalaks to leave the region.
items.name: Mercenary Documents

items.description: Do not eat raw. Risk of hallucinations and diuresis.
items.name: Fungal Thallus

items.description: Cooked poorly, this thallus is as toxic as your grandmother's pies.
items.name: Mycosic Thallus

items.description: Only experienced pickers know how to recover this choice meat without losing a finger.
items.name: Tuberculosic Thallus

items.description:
These mushrooms will help you understand everything. To really appreciate them, you need to find the right place to savour them in the Fungus Cavern.
Double-click to use.
items.name: Fungal Pan Fry

items.description: Sticky and evil-smelling, this sporm is not edible.
items.name: Gelatinous Sporm

items.description: Sticky and evil-smelling, this sporm is not edible.
items.name: Viscous Sporm

items.description: Sticky and evil-smelling, this sporm is not edible.
items.name: Mucous Sporm

items.description: Sticky and evil-smelling, this sporm is not edible.
items.name: Icky Sporm

items.description: According to legend, this fruit is popular with the spirits of the undergrowth.
items.name: Sarsaparilla

items.description: You've learned the basics of fishing for mushrooms using this fishing rod.
items.name: Fungal Fishing Rod

items.description: This mushroom seems able to neutralise the desire to sleep, in return for an extremely strong addiction.
items.name: Somnitia Sleep-Killer

items.description: This mushroom seems able to neutralise the desire to sleep, in return for an extremely strong addiction.
items.name: Grilled Somnitia Sleep-Killer

items.description: Its cold, dull blade means the fire that brought it to life went out long ago.
items.name: Inert Fiery Tongue Sword

items.description: Brakmarian Dragoturkeys have a few hairs on their chin. They're rare, and could therefore be of some value, nonetheless, their usefulness is questionable.
items.name: Brakmarian Dragoturkey Hair

items.description: A balloon filled with alchemical gas, intended to make the audience laugh during Magik Riktus performances.
items.name: Amusing Balloon

items.description: A balloon filled with alchemical gas, intended to make the audience laugh during Magik Riktus performances.
items.name: Funny Balloon

items.description: A balloon filled with alchemical gas, intended to make the audience laugh during Magik Riktus performances.
items.name: Hilarious Balloon

items.description: This slobber is cursed, so avoid smearing it on your body.
items.name: Infected Slobber

items.description: This tooth is cursed, so avoid scratching yourself with it.
items.name: Infected Fang

items.description: If Sionverin is to be believed, this kibble could calm down Canynan, chief of the Merians. It's good to regain your strength when you feel beaten, but there are limits, all the same.
items.name: Soothing Biscuit

items.description: This device was invented by a Foggernaut engineer so he could find out if the soup wasn't too hot, and thereby avoid burning his tongue. He had named it "Thermal Meet Her", but that didn't mean anything, and nobody understood what it was used for. It ended up being called "Climate Measurement Device" for greater clarity.
items.name: Climate Measurement Device

items.description: The Cybwork Mercenary is a big, tough guy. When he was little, he stole the other children's snacks. One day, one of them rebelled against him and gave him a hiding. Since that day, he leaves a stress mark in his underpants every time he gets beaten.
items.name: Cybwork Mercenary's Stress-Marked Underpants

items.description: A bone that seems to be carved in stone.
items.name: Stone Bone

items.description: A sharp bone that seems to be made from dried mud.
items.name: Mud Bone

items.description: A bone encrusted with scales.
items.name: Scale Bone

items.description: A bone with a metallic texture.
items.name: Iron Bone

items.description: A bone covered in dried blood.
items.name: Blood Bone

items.description: A bone encrusted with dust.
items.name: Dust Bone

items.description: If you have a Piece of Young Shoot on you, it's because you were attacked by young mushroom shoots. Depending on the variety, it could be because you're ugly, or because you smell bad, for example.
items.name: Piece of Young Shoot

items.description: Shushu Ravi Horns are destructive, dark, demonic, dastardly... But that's quite normal when you know where they come from.
items.name: Shushu Ravi Horn

items.description:
This page seems to have been torn out of an old spellbook. You found it in the ashes of a campfire.
(Double-click to read what's written on the document)
items.name: Half-Burned Page

items.description:
This page seems to have been torn out of an old spellbook. You found it in a pile of sawdust, under some old, rotten planks.
(Double-click to read what's written on the document)
items.name: Sawdust-Covered Page

items.description:
This page seems to have been torn out of an old spellbook. You found it near a tomb.
(Double-click to read what's written on the document)
items.name: Tooth-Torn Page

items.description:
This page seems to have been torn out of an old spellbook. You found it near a sacrificial altar.
(Double-click to read what's written on the document)
items.name: Bloodstained Page

items.description: You have received confirmation that vampires hate the smell of garlic. And they're not the only ones. Certain goddesses also have a profound aversion for this strongly flavoured plant.
items.name: Clove of Garlic

items.description: This potion was stolen from Brumen Tinctorias's LaboRATory.
items.name: Brumen's Labratory Potion

items.description: This liquid was harvested from Brumen Tinctorias's LaboRATory.
items.name: Brumen's Labratory Liquid

items.description: These notes are a copy of what was found in Brumen Tinctorias's LaboRATory.
items.name: Brumen's Labratory Notes

items.description: These samples were harvested from a Macian brought back from the dead by Brumen Tinctorias.
items.name: Samples of Macian

items.description: This potion was stolen from Brumen Tinctorias's LaboRATory.
items.name: Brumen's Labratory Potion

items.description: These samples were taken from Nelween.
items.name: Samples of Nelween

items.description: These notes are a copy of what was found in Brumen Tinctorias's LaboRATory.
items.name: Brumen's Labratory Notes

items.description: It is not advisable to drink this toxic sample, which is why it can be found in numerous drinks.
items.name: Sample of Liquid

items.description: Even when cut, these plants can still bite imprudent florists.
items.name: Sample of Plants

items.description: It is not advisable to sniff these ashes unless you want to blow out a few neurons. Iops can therefore sniff them all day long.
items.name: Sample of Ashes

items.description: One of the attackers hadn't shaved their armpit hair. It's done now.
items.name: Armpit Hair

items.description: It'll take a few minutes for this mark in your lower back to disappear.
items.name: Bouncer's Mark

items.description: This Old Tinned Food is empty.
items.name: Old Tinned Food

items.description: This peduncle shines not as bright as a torch, but brighter than a Iop.
items.name: Sacred Peduncle

items.description: The word "Bigglip" can be made out on it.
items.name: Suspicious Necklace

items.description: The necklace has turned into a spoon.
items.name: Sugar Spoon

items.description: It would seem you're reached the end of this trail.
items.name: Black Watchdog's Boney-O

items.description: This crate contains many suppositories in the shape of a mushroom. Their size indicates they are not to be used by Twelvians, unless they want to enter the record books.
items.name: Crate of Suppositories

items.description: Now you have a watermelon. Does that make you happy?
items.name: Ohwymi Watermelon

items.description: This document, signed by a member of the Magik Riktus, obliges him to work part time for the clan's musicologist.
items.name: Signed Magik Riktus Document

items.description: You've found out that the price of the wood used to make Forfut coffins was about to soar. That doesn't really help you on your mission, but you can't say you didn't know now.
items.name: Forfut Rumour

items.description: Apparently, the restoration work at Forfut Castle is progressing well. And to think you almost missed out on this information.
items.name: Forfut Rumour

items.description: The Shushess intends to increase the local taxes paid by the citizens of Forfut Village. If you live here, you'd be outraged, but since that isn't the case, it doesn't bother you either way.
items.name: Forfut Rumour

items.description: This crate contains several Magik Riktus costumes.
items.name: Crate of Costumes

items.description: Having been deprived of this accessory, Tangfatic's henchman won't be rolling around any more.
items.name: Riktus Wheel

items.description: Is this fabric or fur? There's still some room for doubt. One thing is certain: you won't be able to do much with this thing.
items.name: Hairy Fabric

items.description: A single word all it takes to describe this evil-smelling puddle of mud: yuck.
items.name: Yuckugh Mud

items.description: The text scribbled on this torn page is quite simply illegible. It's just as well, because that way, you won't have to risk your mental health trying to decipher it.
items.name: Illegible Page

items.description: Vampires love red roses. Maybe it's because they can't feel their thorns... They can't be cut to the quick.
items.name: Blood Flower

items.description: These documents were founds in Magik Hermiktus's things.
items.name: Magik Hermiktus's Documents

items.description: This strange dessert doesn't look at all appetising.
items.name: Sorbet Twelvian Brain

items.description: This cape, discovered in a secret room of the Tower of Gisgoul, is absolutely soaked in blood.
items.name: Blood-Soaked Cape

items.description: When a goblin decides to brood, it's difficult to turn them around. Best wait until it passes. Anyway, after a few minutes, he'll have already forgotten all about it.
items.name: Brooding Goblin

items.description:
This bag, covered with mineral dust, contains Bontarian clothing and some documents.
Double-click to use.
items.name: Dusty Bag

items.description:
These notes were found in a ritualist's belongings.
Double-click to use.
items.name: Notes of a Ritualist

items.description: A cold, foamy beer.
items.name: Cold Beer

items.description: The smell coming off the plants in this chest is likely to attract all the coprophagous creatures in the area.
items.name: Rats' Chest

items.description: This bag emits a really awful stench somewhere between that of a Stink Bomb, a Sadida's foot bath and a bunch of Enutrofs' dirty underwear.
items.name: Bag of Smelliting Seeds

items.description: This notebook contains a number of observations made by doctors, mages and other healers of the militia.
items.name: Notes On The Epidemic

items.description: These blood samples have been taken from contaminated militiamen.
items.name: Militiamen's Blood Samples

items.description: This potion isn't supposed to be ingested, so its effects on digestion are as of yet unknown. Any volunteers?
items.name: Benn Zeen's Potion

items.description: The way in which this strange technomagical item works is a mystery to those who've never been taught how to use it.
items.name: Rooky Rolscuba's Oscillator

items.description: Thanks to a few modifications made by Nina Scharp, this oscillator can detect residual Black Fire. The main problem, apart from its fragility, is its extremely limited range.
items.name: Nina Scharp's Oscillator

items.description: This Krobian stem cell was taken from a Krobe mutated by the Black Fire.
items.name: Krobian Stem Cell

items.description: Theoretically, these antidotes can heal the sick without killing them.
items.name: Nina Scharp's Box of Antidotes

items.description: The text, although legible, seems to be hiding a code that's difficult to decrypt. The document bears Hogmeiser's signature and seal.
items.name: Coded Document

items.description: According to Cam Arilla, this key is used to open something in Twist Ham Cathedral. A fat lot of good knowing that will do you.
items.name: Cam Arilla's Key

items.description: Originally, several of these spheres were bound together by string. We don't know why Bella Mentary made them. She kept quiet about the question and double-locked herself in her bedroom when she wanted to use them.
items.name: Bella Mentary's Sphere

items.description: You've reduced years of work into ashes. Let's hope the game's worth it.
items.name: Bella Mentary's Sphere Ashes

items.description:
It might not taste like anything special, but the new Bojaway is sold at a price that tourists consider to be extortionate.
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Bottle of Bojaway

items.description: This juice is made from fermented cereals, which was once considered the ideal breakfast for little Pandawas.
items.name: Sacred Cereal Juice

items.description:
Will adding Sutol make it taste better or worse?
(Double-click to use.)
items.name: Altered Cereal Juice

items.description: This purse contains a lot of money.
items.name: Dark Court Purse

items.description: This elixir makes the drinker shine in all circumstances, whether they're making a speech, doing manual labour or are on an expedition to the underworld.
items.name: Shine Elixir

items.description: This scarf is soft and light, just like the caresses of a young Eniripsa.
items.name: Silk Scarf

items.description: These documents are a compilation of Erzal's extensive research on wells of power.
items.name: Erzal's Documents

items.description: This piece of rock burns with an all-consuming energy. And yet, you feel an intense cold when you touch it... Images of rotting bodies haunt your mind. That should be enough to dissuade you from keeping it with you for very long.
items.name: Magma Shard

items.description: If you put this vitrified stone close to your ear, you'll think you can hear a distant moan that makes you soul tremble... This sorrowful song sounds like a warning.
items.name: Wind Shard

items.description: For some people, the sea is a source of life and a generous benefactor of constantly renewed beauty. For others, it is a wild mistress, remorselessly killing those who would try to tame it... When you gaze deeply into the depths of this shard, you feel the weight of the waters on your shoulders. Be careful not to gaze upon it for too long, or you may never be able to come back up to the surface.
items.name: Ocean Shard

items.description: This powerful, protective talisman was given to you by the goddess Feca herself. You therefore attach more importance to it than whatever's usually lying around in your bag. Thanks to the Aegis, you'll be able to cross the borders of the regions haunted by the Veriun Dead without fear of joining their ranks. Rest assured: you'll still be able to die, but in a clean fashion.
items.name: Feca's Aegis

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: According to Gobannus, this rock has the power to petrify the Veriun Dead... at least when used while charged with divine energy. For the moment, it simply deforms your pockets.
items.name: Block of Raw Necronyx

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This doll is needed for the bewitchment of Necronyx. Avoid playing with it; your past the age for that.
items.name: Necronyx Doll

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: Unless a doctor helps you, such as Herr Peece, you'll have to accept the consequences of your poor hygiene.
items.name: Infectious Fungal Infection

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: On this list, there are many things Zrid Rahys needs to complete his experiments.
items.name: Zrid's List

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This parasite is more impressive than it is dangerous.
items.name: Drowhirl Parasite

type.name: Towers of the Brotherhood of the Forgotten

items.description: This parasite is more impressive than it is dangerous.
items.name: Funerbroadsword Parasite

items.name: Micrab Parasite
